title: [3D] Admission control + capacity certificate
description:
[3D] Admission control + queueing policy + the capacity certificate.

WHAT: server-mode admission: each incoming request is admitted only if the capacity model says the socket can hold it (streams x per-stream budgets <= physical-core + bandwidth budget; per-request resource admission from the reliability gates composes in); configurable queue delay (batching efficiency vs p95 admission-to-first-packet latency); overload behavior = fast structured rejection, never silent degradation of admitted streams. THE CAPACITY CERTIFICATE (a gauntlet artifact): p95/p99 queueing evidence under load, proof of no nested-runtime/no oversubscription (one fan-out), the topology + policy assumptions — published per SKU class.

METRICS OWNED HERE (the throughput-profile headline set): aggregate RTF (generated-audio-seconds per wall-clock second per socket), streams/socket, p95 admission-to-first-packet queueing latency, joules per generated minute (OQ-17 method).

DONE WHEN: admission + queueing implemented + load-tested (including overload + burst patterns with detailed logs); certificate generated per test SKU; metrics wired into the bench harness + scorecard.

title: [3A/AF-3] E-value reliability monitor (speculation kill-switch)
description:
[3A/AF-3] The e-value reliability monitor + FrankenMTP kill-switch.

WHAT (alien-artifact family AF-3 — consumer: the FrankenMTP kill-switch; deletion condition: FrankenMTP abandoned): an anytime-valid sequential test (e-process) monitoring the speculative path in production — bounding the rate of draft-path misbehavior (disagreement beyond expectation, repair-loop anomalies, invariant near-misses) at risk level alpha; alarm -> automatic fallback to the exact sequential path + a health event through SynthesisObserver/robot; alpha->0 disables speculation entirely (the deterministic fallback, wired FIRST).

WHY AN E-PROCESS: valid at every stopping time without multiple-testing penalties — the right tool for an always-on production monitor (Ville's inequality), matching the gauntlet's invariant-monitoring machinery.

EXPLICITLY NOT: an exactness proof (that is OQ-19). This is the runtime insurance that makes shipping speculation responsible even at Tier 1.

DONE WHEN: monitor implemented + calibration fixture committed (p0/lambda/alpha choices documented on the transparency card); fault-injection tests (deliberately broken drafter -> alarm + fallback); assumptions ledger + deterministic fallback demonstrated.

title: [3D] Continuous frame/depth batching scheduler
description:
[3D] Continuous frame/depth batching scheduler.

WHAT: the AMD-throughput architecture: a central frame scheduler that (per scheduling quantum) collects all streams ready for their next frame, batches the TALKER step across them (GEMV -> GEMM; weights read once per step, not once per stream), then for residual_depth 0..14 batches THAT DEPTH across all active streams (valid because streams are independent — each stream's depth-d token depends only on its OWN depth-(d-1); batching per depth respects every stream's autoregressive chain), then batches/pipelines codec packets, then returns each stream to its own sequential state.

OWNERSHIP INVARIANT (doctrine 5): this scheduler IS the engine's single parallel owner — multi-stream inside ONE fan-out, never N concurrent fan-outs; fttsd admission later rides the same capacity model. Two policies: Latency (one stream, small static team, minimal queueing) and Throughput (continuous batching, configurable queue delay, weight-stationary scheduling, NUMA-local packs).

CORRECTNESS: batch==singleton per stream (strict mode) — every stream's output identical to solo execution; the -1B answer to "at what stream count does batched GEMM overtake per-stream GEMV" sets the batching threshold.

DONE WHEN: batch==singleton green; aggregate-RTF/socket + streams/socket measured vs the isolated-engines alternative (the win must be demonstrated, not assumed); queue-delay policy tunable + documented.

title: [3C] Optimized stateful codec kernels (fused, ring-buffer)
description:
[3C] Optimized stateful codec kernels.

WHAT: the codec decoder at kernel quality co-equal with the talker work (the classic TTS-port blind spot is optimizing the LM and discovering the codec dominates): stateful causal Conv1d with persistent ring buffers (receptive-field-sized from OQ-7, preallocated, state across packets); FUSED conv+bias+norm+activation (one pass per conv, ring-buffer-aware); specialized small attention at the exact codec shape (hidden 512, 16 heads x head_dim 64 — attention width 1024 = 2x hidden — sliding window 72; a dedicated fixed-shape variant, not the talker kernel); NO im2col materialization (direct conv loops at these small fixed shapes; LLVM autovec where int8 does not apply); upsample [8,5,4,3] streaming DIRECTLY into the output PCM buffer; distinct encode/decode builds preserved.

QUANT MODE: per KernelPlan (the codec conv may be a W8A16 or BF16 winner — the -1B bench decides, not assumption); RVQ codebooks stay high-precision.

DONE WHEN: bit-identical to the Phase-1 codec in strict mode; codec-stage roofline distance published; codec_packet_1/2/4 benches wired; overflow rows for conv reduction lengths in the selftest.

title: [3A] FrankenMTP v1 (drafter 1 + greedy speculation)
description:
[3A] FrankenMTP v1: drafter #1 + greedy-mode speculative decode.

WHAT: the first end-to-end speculative loop: drafter #1 = previous-frame residuals + a small transition model (counting statistics from generated audio — NO gradient training, NO lab dependency); verify the drafted block via the seq-16 kernel; STRICT/GREEDY MODE acceptance = "draft id equals verifier argmax at that position" — token-identical to sequential greedy BY CONSTRUCTION; at first rejection, take the verifier's argmax at that position, then REGENERATE the remaining depths (sequential-suffix vs re-draft+re-verify — a measured policy choice; NEVER verify the stale suffix, its context changed); fall back to pure sequential when acceptance is poor.

THE RANKING GATE: keep/revert judged against the -1B break-even curve alpha*(SKU) using the expected-case cost T(alpha) = T_draft + T_verify + (1-alpha_full)*T_repair — partial accepts at depth k can be WORSE than pure sequential; the high-acceptance asymptote (~0.55 GB/frame; 5x-RT demand dropping from ~103 GB/s sequential-baseline toward mid-30s) is the ceiling, not the plan. NOTE the per-SKU composition with the hot pack: where residency holds, the win is serial latency/compute shape; where it fails, this is the traffic lever.

INVARIANTS (already registered in the metamorphic bead, activate here): greedy FrankenMTP ids == greedy sequential ids; speculation-off == sequential byte-for-byte (strict).

DONE WHEN: measured alpha per corpus segment; keep/revert verdict vs alpha*(SKU) with thermal-paired A/B receipts; ledger row either way; kill-switch (FTTS_SPEC_MTP) with structurally unchanged unarmed path.

title: [3A] Exact-shape int8 kernels + KernelPlan autotuner
description:
[3A] Exact-shape int8 GEMV/GEMM kernels + KernelPlan autotuner v1.

WHAT (in ftts-kernels, the only unsafe-permitted crate; every intrinsic island named, SAFETY-commented, feature-gated, with a bit-identical scalar fallback that cross-compiles everywhere): the model's exact shapes hardcoded (1024->2048, 1024->1024, 2048->1024, 1024->3072, 3072->1024, the 2048-way heads, codec 512-family): aarch64 SDOT (+SMMLA where measured to win — inherited prior: M4 SMMLA issues at half rate, prefer SDOT on macOS; REVERIFY per toolchain), x86 AVX-512-VNNI / AVX-VNNI (U8S8 with the +128 fold) / AVX2 (vpmaddubsw with its own saturation proof), scalar floor. i32 accumulation, scales post-accumulation, fused bias/activation + requant. The KernelPlan autotuner v1: seeded from -1B W8A8/W8A16 winners, measures per (op x shape x m-regime x ISA) on install, persists to .fttspack; NO fixed ISA hierarchy.

BINDING CONSTRAINTS (inherited, re-confirm locally): never hand-SIMD the glue (norms/softmax/dequant — LLVM autovec won; ~5x lesson); register/cache blocking mandatory for any SMMLA/tile path (unblocked SMMLA lost to SDOT); autovec BEAT hand-SDOT at m=1 on M4 — the scalar-autovec variant is a live KernelPlan candidate, not just a fallback.

DONE WHEN: every kernel bit-identical to scalar on every tier (integer exactness — SIMD==scalar i32 equality, no tolerance); overflow selftest rows pass; autotuned plan beats any fixed assignment on at least one SKU (else ledger why); benches per shape wired.
notes: POLISH R9 SPLIT: the KernelPlan AUTOTUNER is now its own bead (k-kernelplan-autotuner) — this bead owns the KERNEL IMPLEMENTATIONS ONLY (per-ISA int8 GEMV/GEMM at the exact model shapes, bit-identical to scalar on every tier, overflow selftest rows). The autotuner bead owns the winner-search engine, plan persistence, and doctor re-tune integration. Rationale: a search/measurement engine bundled inside a kernel bead hid its distinct correctness surface (timing hygiene, plan stability, invalidation).

title: [3A] KernelPlan autotuner (per-shape winner search)
description:
[3A] KernelPlan autotuner (split from the kernel implementations — it is a search engine, not a kernel).

WHAT: the install-time/first-run autotuner that binds each op to its winning implementation per (op class x exact shape x m-regime x ISA tier x quant execution mode): candidate space seeded from the -1B W8A8/W8A16 microbenchmark winners; measures on THIS machine (warmup discard, cv% gate, refusal on incoherent timings); persists the plan into .fttspack keyed by the full compatibility tuple; robot backends reports the active plan; FTTS_FORCE_ARCH overrides for A/B and debugging.

WHY ITS OWN BEAD: the autotuner is a measurement+search engine with its own correctness concerns (timing hygiene, plan stability, cache invalidation) — bundling it inside the kernel-implementation bead hid that scope. NO FIXED ISA HIERARCHY is the doctrine (AMX excellent at big tiles, poor at batch-one GEMV; M4 prefers SDOT over SMMLA; autovec-scalar beat hand-SDOT at m=1 in the sibling campaign — the scalar-autovec variant is a LIVE candidate, not just a fallback).

DONE WHEN: autotune produces a persisted KernelPlan that beats any fixed assignment on at least one SKU (else simplified away with a ledger row); plan regeneration deterministic given the key tuple; corrupted/stale plan detection + safe re-tune (doctor integration); every candidate binding covered by the bit-identical selftest before it is eligible; structured logs of the full search (candidates, timings, cv%, winner rationale).

title: [3A] KernelTeam (persistent workers, N-bucket rebind)
description:
[3A] KernelTeam: the fixed hot-loop execution architecture.

WHAT: fixed, long-lived workers executing the hot math (replacing rayon on the decode path — v1 had three scheduling systems, one too many): static output-channel partitions per op; sense-reversing barrier / generation counter; per-op ACTIVE worker counts (a 1024-row GEMV may want 4 workers while a seq-16 block pass wants 12 — counts from the AF-5 USL sweep, 3D bead); no closures, no work-stealing, no per-layer task submission in steady state; affinity from the hardware plan (P-cores on Apple; CCD-aware on AMD); the ONE-PARALLEL-OWNER-AT-A-TIME invariant enforced by construction. VARIABLE BATCH SIZE IS A DESIGNED CASE: precomputed partition tables per N-bucket; rebind only at scheduling-quantum boundaries; hysteresis so churn cannot thrash the plan (continuous batching changes N every quantum).

DIVISION OF LABOR: asupersync = orchestration/cancellation/IO only; KernelTeam = hot math; rayon remains for the f32 port, converters, enrollment — and as the CORRECTNESS/PERF INCUMBENT the team must measurably beat to land (keep-gate; else revert + ledger).

WHY: at 12.5 frames/s x (28 + 15x5) layer evaluations, per-step overhead (pool wakeups, task objects, allocator) is a visible fraction of each 80 ms budget; a persistent dispatch-free team converts directly into TTFA and RTF.

DONE WHEN: team runs the talker+microdecoder loops bit-identically to the rayon baseline; A/B shows the win (thermal-paired, cv<=5); no allocation/dispatch in steady state (verified by instrumentation); watchdog + loom-style/stress tests for the barrier protocol.

title: [3B] Long-context KV layout + admission integration
description:
[3B] Long-context KV layout + admission integration.

WHAT: the talker KV cache engineered for the full duration range: contiguous per-head layout streamed once per step (layout is the win at these lengths — 12.5 frames/s means even 10 minutes is only ~7500 frames + prompt; attention compute is minor next to the GEMVs, so no exotic algorithms assumed necessary — online-softmax tiling only if profiles ever show cache hostility); preallocation from the census per admitted request; growth beyond the context limit follows the OFFICIAL long-form chunking policy (OQ-6) — never an invented rolling-window scheme; integration with resource admission (predicted max frames -> KV bytes -> admit/reject BEFORE allocation).

DONE WHEN: KV layout benchmarked vs alternatives at short/medium/long-form durations; admission formulas tested at the boundaries (max duration, context limit); long-form runs exercise the official chunking path with parity spot-checks vs the oracle's long-form output.

comments.author: cc_11
comments.text:
[from OQ-6, docs/QWEN3_TTS_DECODE_AND_ADMISSION.md sec 5] KV sizing, from config.json re-read (not
inherited): talker 28 layers, 16 Q / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128 -> 2 x 8 x 128 = 2048 values per token
per layer x 28 = 57,344 values/token = 112 KiB/token BF16 (224 KiB F32).
  KV_talker(L_prompt, N_frames) = (L_prompt + N_frames) x 57,344 x sizeof(dtype)
  8192-frame cap + 512-token prompt = 952 MiB BF16; full 32768 context = 3.50 GiB BF16.
This is the ONLY term that grows with duration. Bounded terms: microdecoder KV = 5 layers x <=16
positions x 8 KV x 128 x 2 = 163,840 values = 320 KiB BF16, reset per frame (confirms plan 2.5's
'tiny -- comfortably cache-resident', and restates the plan's central point: the microdecoder's
problem is its WEIGHTS, never its history); codec decoder KV = 8 x 72 x 16 x 64 x 2 = 1,179,648
values = 2.25 MiB BF16 (sliding window 72 bounds it -- see OQ-7 sec 6).
Binding limit is max_new_tokens (default 8192), not the 32768 context ceiling: 32768 only binds above
~24,500 prompt tokens, unreachable under the 8192 cap.

title: [3D] NUMA-local packs + CCD affinity
description:
[3D] NUMA-local packs + CCD affinity.

WHAT: on multi-die AMD (Threadripper/EPYC): replicate or partition the .fttspack weight sections NUMA-node-locally (cross-node weight fetches are the silent killer; the read-only hot sections replicate cheaply when concurrency warrants); pin stream cohorts + their KernelTeam workers CCD-aware; first-touch or explicit replication policy via FTTS_NUMA={replicate|interleave|local} (default local + first-touch); per-node activation buffers.

WHY: continuous batching multiplies bandwidth demand; a 64-core EPYC serving cross-CCD weight reads throttles on infinity-fabric, not DRAM. The -1B per-CCD residency data feeds placement.

DONE WHEN: NUMA policies implemented behind the env switch; measured streams/socket + aggregate RTF with/without locality on a multi-CCD box; policy defaults set from measurement; capacity certificate records the topology assumptions.

title: [OQ-19/3A] Sampled-mode speculative rule + proof
description:
[OQ-19 / 3A] Sampled-mode speculative rule: named algorithm + distributional-correctness proof.

WHAT (A RESEARCH DELIVERABLE, not a checklist row): the production sampler runs T=0.9/top_k=50 at BOTH levels + repetition penalty on the talker. Sampled-mode FrankenMTP requires a NAMED speculative-sampling algorithm with a proof that: (a) accepted prefixes are distributed EXACTLY as the sequential sampler's output; (b) rejections resample from the verifier's ADJUSTED conditional (never the draft's); (c) top-k truncation interactions are resolved explicitly (truncated supports break naive speculative-sampling acceptance ratios — the modified residual distribution must renormalize over the top-k support); (d) repetition-penalty state interacts correctly across accepted spans.

CATEGORY SEPARATION (v2.1 doctrine): AF-3's e-value bound is a RELIABILITY MONITOR (how often the path misbehaves) — it is NOT a substitute for distributional exactness; "disagreement is rare" and "samples are legal" are different claims. Without this proof, sampled-mode speculation ships ONLY under Tier-2 claims (approximate assistance, Contract-B gates).

DONE WHEN: algorithm written up with the proof (or a documented counter-verdict adopting Tier 2 for sampled mode); implementation + statistical validation (many-seed distribution comparison vs pure sequential sampling at matched logits); the claim tier recorded in the ledger and release docs.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text:
[from OQ-5, AzureThrush] CLAIM TIER VERDICT: **TIER 1** -- the training-mode causal forward IS mask- and distribution-equivalent to the 15-step sequential inference loop. Exact-verifier claims are LICENSED. Full line-cited derivation: docs/truth-pack/OQ5_MICRODECODER_WIRING.md.

The index map you must implement (identical in both paths, proven executably by scripts/oq5_index_equivalence.py):
  pos 0        = talker hidden state (conditioning, NOT scored)
  pos 1        = TALKER codec embedding (vocab 3072) of c0  -> lm_head[0]   -> c1
  pos 2..15    = code_predictor.codec_embedding[p-2] (vocab 2048) of c_{p-1} -> lm_head[p-1] -> c_p
Mask: plain 16x16 lower-triangular causal, positions 0..15, no sliding (all 5 layer_types are full_attention, sliding_window null). Rotary: plain RoPE theta 1e6, no scaling.

TWO TRAPS, both of which silently invalidate the epic:
1. Position 1 is SCORED. Plan §7.5's phrasing ('one conditioning/primary position plus 15 residual positions') reads as though c0's slot were unscored; it is not. Count is right, head placement is easy to get one off.
2. Position 1's embedding comes from the TALKER's table, not a code_predictor table.

NUMERICAL CAVEAT (see docs/truth-pack/OQ5_MICRODECODER_WIRING.md §6): equivalence is exact in exact arithmetic. A seq-16 batched matmul and 15 m=1 GEMVs may differ in reduction order / last ULPs. Strict-mode acceptance must compare ARGMAX/token ids, not logit bits, unless the verify kernel reproduces the sequential reduction order exactly. Ledger a DISCREPANCIES entry when the verify kernel lands.

HONESTY NOTE: this verdict is [VERIFIED-STATIC] (line-level reading of pinned source + pinned config). Numeric oracle confirmation is frankentts-m1u, blocked on the oracle env. If m1u ever contradicts this, the Tier-1 verdict re-opens and this comment is wrong.

title: [3C] Packet autotuning + profile wiring
description:
[3C] Packet autotuning + profile wiring.

WHAT: packet size (1/2/4/auto frames) as a true execution-policy parameter: the auto policy selects per (SKU, profile) from the -1B packet experiments + local autotune; profiles map interactive->1-2 frames (first audible sample sooner: 80-160 ms of audio per packet), balanced->4 (the official 320 ms packetization), throughput->larger codec batches where measured to help, strict->conformance packetization exactly matching the official streaming semantics (OQ-14). Cancellation checks EVERY 80 ms talker frame regardless of packet size (G8); packet metadata flows through audio_chunk robot events.

DONE WHEN: profile->packet defaults justified from data (committed table); packet-equality metamorphic gate green across all sizes; TTFA per profile measured + reported per SKU; auto policy beats any fixed choice on at least one SKU or is simplified away (ledgered).

title: [3B] PGO + BOLT build-time optimization
description:
[3B] Build-time optimization: PGO + BOLT on the shipping binary.

WHAT (plan section 7.14 — free, model-agnostic levers, do them all): (a) verify the shipping profile is LTO=fat + codegen-units=1 + panic=abort and the separate release-perf profile (frame pointers, line tables) is used for ALL profiling — never profile the size/abort build; (b) PGO: instrument, run the golden synthesis corpus (representative short + medium + long-form items — the nested frame loop's branch structure: router-free but sampler top-k, ring-buffer wraps, packet boundaries, stop-rule checks is exactly what PGO straightens), rebuild with the profile; bake one profdata per release; (c) BOLT post-link optimization on top of PGO for I-cache/branch layout of the hot kernel loops (the classic last-5-10% lever); (d) confirm target-feature + runtime dispatch (NEVER target-cpu=native — we ship one portable binary per OS/arch and select ISA at runtime).

GATES: standard perf-ritual — bit-identical output proof BEFORE speed measurement (PGO/BOLT must not change numerics: same tokens, same PCM in strict mode); interleaved thermal-paired A/B; keep/revert + ledger row; cv%<=5.

DONE WHEN: PGO+BOLT pipeline scripted + reproducible in the release build; measured deltas ledgered per SKU; strict-mode identity verified post-BOLT; documented in the release recipe.

title: [3B] Tiled register-blocked prefill GEMM (the wedge)
description:
[3B] Register-blocked tiled prefill GEMM (the wedge kernel).

WHAT: the tiled, register-blocked SMMLA/VNNI int8 GEMM for prefill-class shapes (long-m text/ICL prompt processing + the text projection MLP 2048->2048->1024) — the kernel frankentorch NAMES but does not ship; building it is our wedge. Requirements from the inherited graveyard: register/cache blocking with compute:load >= 2:1 (an unblocked SMMLA with 2x MAC density LOST to SDOT — load-bound); offline weight pre-packing into the tile layout (.fttspack; zero runtime shuffle); B stays in native [out,in] checkpoint layout (no transpose ever); L2-blocked B-panels.

WHY PREFILL MATTERS: TTFA (the interactive profile's headline) = prefill + first frame + first codec packet; ICL prompts (reference text + codec tokens + target text) can be hundreds of positions; this GEMM is that path's floor. Also serves the seq-16 verification pass and 3D batched execution (m = stream count).

DONE WHEN: bit-identical (i32-exact) to scalar; beats the GEMV-loop alternative at prefill shapes on every target ISA (else ledgered); prefill-stage bench + roofline distance recorded; TTFA delta measured end-to-end.

title: [3A] MTP-first Q4 depth waterfall (double-gated)
description:
[3A] MTP-first Q4: packed int4 kernel + depth waterfall (double-gated).

WHAT: a genuinely NATIVE packed Q4 kernel (in-register unpack feeding the same int8 MAC units — there is no CPU int4 multiply; the win is bytes streamed, and the inherited prior says unpack cost made int4 5.8x SLOWER in a sibling at different shapes — REPROVE at ours), then the placement waterfall IN THIS ORDER: (1) later microdecoder residual depths only, (2) whole microdecoder body, (3) microdecoder heads, (4) talker MLPs, (5) talker attention projections.

WHY MICRODECODER-FIRST (inverted from the naive talker-first order): the body is reread 15x per frame — Q4 shrinks ~79 MB toward ~40 MB, potentially buying CACHE RESIDENCY on SKUs where Q8 fails (a step-function win, not a linear one); later acoustic codebook depths are plausibly less perceptually sensitive than the first semantic-rich code; an MTP-only rollback is clean. PER-DEPTH PRECISION IS A FIRST-CLASS AXIS (AF-1 formalizes the allocation in Phase 5).

THE DOUBLE GATE (both required): (a) faster END-TO-END on each actual target ISA including unpack cost; (b) blind listeners cannot distinguish it under the equivalence-bound protocol on identity, naturalness, sibilance, breath, pitch stability, long-form prosody. A smaller file that runs slower or subtly damages identity is a FAILED artifact.

DONE WHEN: kernel + overflow row + per-depth waterfall measurements; verdict per placement stage with receipts (keep/revert each independently); ledger rows; .fttsq/.fttspack support for mixed per-depth precision.

title: [3D] Ragged FrankenMTP x batching joint scheduler
description:
[3D] Ragged FrankenMTP x batching: the joint scheduler design.

WHAT (v2.1 hardness item — two flagship systems must share ONE scheduler design, not meet by accident in production): under speculation, streams reject at different depths, so depth-synchronized batching goes RAGGED. Design + measure the joint policy; candidates: pad-and-mask cohorts (verify all streams to depth 15, mask rejected tails); cohort splitting by accept depth; a DUAL-LANE scheduler (block-verify lane + sequential-repair lane, streams migrating between lanes per frame); per-cohort re-drafting. Jointly owned by 3A (speculation semantics) + 3D (batching mechanics); the KernelTeam's N-bucket rebind rules (hysteresis, quantum-boundary rebinding) absorb the resulting batch-size churn.

DECISION CRITERIA: aggregate RTF under mixed acceptance distributions (from 3A's measured alpha), tail latency of repair-lane streams, scheduler complexity. Pure-sequential-lane fallback is always available (speculation off per stream).

DONE WHEN: chosen policy implemented + A/B-ed against speculation-off batching under realistic acceptance mixes; per-stream strict-mode identity still green (batching + speculation composed); design doc committed as the shared 3A/3D artifact.

title: [3A] ResidualCodeDecoder engine + MTP hot pack
description:
[3A] ResidualCodeDecoder: the dedicated microdecoder engine + MTP hot pack.

WHAT: a dedicated engine, NOT a generic mini-transformer: fixed 15-step loop, fixed 5-layer topology, compile-time shapes; tiny fixed-size KV arrays RESET once per frame (<=16 positions — lives in private cache; its weights, not its attention history, are the problem); precomputed plain-RoPE table for positions 0-15 (16 rows — no trig in the loop); direct per-depth embedding + head selection (indexed arrays, no dispatch); NO dynamic cache objects, NO generation machinery, NO allocation, NO full probability vectors outside the top-k/sampler path. THE MTP HOT PACK in .fttspack: the FULL ~110 MB-class hot working set (body ~79 MB + 15 heads ~31.5 MB + depth embeds + scales + RoPE table + scratch; exact bytes from OQ-2) physically separated, layout tuned for residency across the 15 steps, benchmarked against the talker's generic layout.

PHYSICS HONESTY (v2.1): in exact sequential mode there is NO cross-step scheduling freedom (step t+1 depends on step t's sampled token) — the win here is pure cache residency + layout; true weight-stationary execution exists ONLY in the FrankenMTP verification pass and cross-stream batching. If residency fails on a SKU (per the -1B/OQ-18 verdict), the engineered failure playbook applies: Q4 depth waterfall, head/embedding packing, software prefetch at layer boundaries, huge pages, CCD/SLC pinning — best measured combination ships per SKU via .fttspack.

DONE WHEN: bit-identical to the Phase-1 sequential baseline (greedy ids exact; sampled distribution-equal at matched seeds); measured DRAM bytes/frame vs the one-read floor published per SKU; steady-state zero-allocation verified; per-depth benches (microdecoder_step, microdecoder_frame15) wired.

comments.author: cc_1
comments.text:
TRUTH PACK CORRECTIONS C-2 + C-3 (from frankentts-t-pin-sources-b2u) — both are silent-wrongness traps.

C-2 — per-depth embedding/head index is OFF BY ONE from the natural reading.
List index j (0-based, 15 entries) serves code j+1, NOT code j. Code 0 is embedded by the TALKER's
codec_embedding, not by any microdecoder embedding.
  generate path  modeling_qwen3_tts.py:1684 -> get_input_embeddings()[i](sequences[..., i:i+1])
  training path  modeling_qwen3_tts.py:1620-1626 -> i==0 uses the talker embedding;
                 i>=1 uses code_predictor.get_input_embeddings()[i-1](codec_ids[:, i:i+1])
Indexing depth_emb[i] with code i produces plausible-but-wrong audio and never crashes.

C-3 — the microdecoder's RoPE theta is 1e6, the SAME as the talker's, not 1e4.
'Plain RoPE' means no mRoPE sectioning (rope_scaling: null), NOT a different theta.
code_predictor_config.rope_theta = 1000000. A port defaulting to 1e4 is silently wrong.
(The codec decoder is the one using theta 1e4, with sliding_window 72 — three rotary configs total,
not the two the plan's §2.10 states.)

Also relevant here — E-1: QK-Norm IS present on the microdecoder (modeling_qwen3_tts.py:910-929),
RMSNorm over head_dim only, applied BEFORE RoPE, eps=1e-06. attention_bias: false (no QKV/O biases).

Full detail + citations: docs/truth-pack/FACT_DISPOSITIONS.md (C-2, C-3, E-1).

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text:
[from OQ-5, AzureThrush] CLAIM TIER VERDICT: **TIER 1** -- the training-mode causal forward IS mask- and distribution-equivalent to the 15-step sequential inference loop. Exact-verifier claims are LICENSED. Full line-cited derivation: docs/truth-pack/OQ5_MICRODECODER_WIRING.md.

The index map you must implement (identical in both paths, proven executably by scripts/oq5_index_equivalence.py):
  pos 0        = talker hidden state (conditioning, NOT scored)
  pos 1        = TALKER codec embedding (vocab 3072) of c0  -> lm_head[0]   -> c1
  pos 2..15    = code_predictor.codec_embedding[p-2] (vocab 2048) of c_{p-1} -> lm_head[p-1] -> c_p
Mask: plain 16x16 lower-triangular causal, positions 0..15, no sliding (all 5 layer_types are full_attention, sliding_window null). Rotary: plain RoPE theta 1e6, no scaling.

TWO TRAPS, both of which silently invalidate the epic:
1. Position 1 is SCORED. Plan §7.5's phrasing ('one conditioning/primary position plus 15 residual positions') reads as though c0's slot were unscored; it is not. Count is right, head placement is easy to get one off.

Strict-mode acceptance must compare ARGMAX/token ids, not logit bits, unless the verify kernel reproduces the sequential reduction order exactly. Ledger a DISCREPANCIES entry when the verify kernel lands.

title: [3C] Streaming certification (backpressure, cancel, sustained)
description:
[3C] Streaming certification: backpressure, cancellation, sustained runs.

WHAT: certify the streaming path end-to-end against the reliability contract: streaming==offline BIT-IDENTITY under chunk-boundary fuzz schedules (randomized packet/chunk splits never change output); backpressure (consumer stall parks the producer at the bounded queue; budget then cancels; memory bounded throughout — verified under a deliberately slow consumer); cancellation during codec emission finalizes at the frame boundary with a valid partial WAV; audio/event channel independence (cannot deadlock each other — fault-injection tested); SUSTAINED STREAMING: long-form multi-minute runs at each profile with thermal reporting (the 30-minute sustained gate's streaming half), memory flat (zero steady-state allocation confirmed over time), the many_utterances watchdog extended to streaming mode.

WHY ITS OWN BEAD: streaming failure semantics are where real products die quietly; every failure mode gets a named test with detailed logging, not a hope.

DONE WHEN: all failure-injection scenarios pass with structured errors; sustained runs green with flat memory + thermal logs; streaming rows land in the release scorecard.

title: [3B] Persistent talker loop + two-pass norm-quant fusion
description:
[3B] Persistent talker loop + correct norm->quant fusion.

WHAT: the 28-layer talker on the KernelTeam as a persistent dispatch-free loop. Per-layer fused pass 1: RMSNorm -> QKV -> QK-Norm (if OQ-3 confirmed) -> mRoPE -> GQA attention over the KV cache -> O-proj -> residual. Pass 2: RMSNorm -> gate||up (one input quant shared) -> SiLU-mul -> down -> residual. THE CORRECT TWO-PASS NORM->QUANT FUSION (RMSNorm needs a global reduction before any normalized value exists — one-pass claims are wrong): pass 1 computes sum-of-squares AND max|x_i*gamma_i| in one sweep; derive the RMS factor and the dynamic quant scale (max|normalized| = max|x*gamma|/rms); pass 2 emits QUANTIZED normalized activations directly into aligned scratch — no materialized f32 normalized vector; Q/K/V reuse that one quantized input, gate/up reuse the post-attention norm's. Also fuse residual-add with the NEXT norm's statistics collection where the arithmetic-order contract permits.

STEADY STATE: workers persist across all 28 layers + 15 microdecoder steps + successive frames; zero allocation, zero dispatch; KV preallocated from census.

DONE WHEN: bit-identical to the Phase-1 talker (greedy streams equal; teacher-forced parity re-proven); fusion proven byte-identity-preserving per the equivalence rules; A/B vs unfused with thermal pairing; roofline distance published per SKU.

title: [3D/AF-5] USL pool/team sizing sweeps
description:
[3D/AF-5] USL pool/team sizing sweeps.

WHAT (alien-artifact family AF-5 — consumer: .fttspack pool_sizing + robot backends + the admission policy; deletion condition: fixed counts measure equal): fit the Universal Scalability Law C(N) = N / (1 + a(N-1) + bN(N-1)) to thread sweeps per (arch, op-class): talker GEMV, microdecoder step, seq-16 verify pass, prefill GEMM, codec conv, batched GEMM at several m. CAP each op's active-worker count at its USL peak, never at num_cpus (over-threading a bandwidth-bound GEMV is a measured anti-win — the fitted b term quantifies coherency cost); the results feed the KernelTeam per-op active-worker counts, the N-bucket partition tables, and the continuous-batching admission policy.

DONE WHEN: sweeps run per SKU with cv% gates; fitted curves + chosen caps committed (transparency card: equation, fitted values, plain-English intuition, validity assumptions, flip conditions); measured throughput at chosen N >= throughput at num_cpus on every op class (the proof obligation); fallback (physical-core count) wired first.

title: [3B] Vectorized transcendentals (gated numerics lever)
description:
[3B] Vectorized polynomial transcendentals (the one hand-SIMD exception, gated).

WHAT (plan section 7.2 rider (a)): LLVM will NOT autovectorize exp/sigmoid/tanh — it emits scalar libm calls — so softmax (talker + microdecoder logits paths where full softmax is actually computed; attention softmax) and SiLU/activation glue can be multi-x faster with a range-reduced minimax-polynomial vector exp (std::simd or the proven sibling pattern). THE ONE exception to the never-hand-SIMD-the-glue doctrine — and it is NUMERICS-AFFECTING, so: ships behind a FTTS_VEC_EXP-style kill-switch with a structurally unchanged unarmed path; defaults ON only after a measured A/B PLUS a passing parity gate (Contract-A rungs within floor-derived tolerances; greedy token streams unchanged on the golden corpus); ledgered either way. Also applies to any codec activation that profiles hot (per OQ-7's activation identification).

NOTE ON SCOPE: under greedy decode the lm/code-head path uses argmax-only (no full softmax over the head vocab — that fusion already lives in the kernel beads); the transcendental win concentrates in attention softmax + SiLU + sampled-mode probability computation.

DONE WHEN: vector exp/sigmoid implemented in ftts-kernels (SAFETY-commented islands + scalar fallback); accuracy characterized (max ULP vs libm on the live range); A/B measured per SKU; default decided by measurement; ledger row + parity receipt.

title: [3A] Seq-16 verification kernel (multi-head-per-position)
description:
[3A] The seq-16 verification kernel (multi-head-per-position block pass).

WHAT: the FrankenMTP verifier: run the 5-layer microdecoder body over the 1+15=16-position frame sequence in ONE causal pass (one body read instead of 15; healthier matrix utilization + output-channel parallelism) — but NOT a stock LM pass: each residual position applies its OWN depth-specific embedding to the drafted id and its OWN 2048-way head; the kernel is a custom MULTI-HEAD-PER-POSITION engine (shared body over the sequence + per-position embed/head application), and the per-depth head+embed traffic (~31.5 MB + embeds) is part of its cost model.

CORRECTNESS CONTRACT (OQ-5 decides the claim tier): masking, position ids, and the depth-index -> sequence-index -> head-index mapping must be BIT-EQUIVALENT to the training-mode forward; the primary/conditioning position is FROZEN during verification; the verifier scores exactly the 15 residual positions. An off-by-one here invalidates the flagship — the metamorphic invariant (verify-then-repair can never emit a mask-impossible depth sequence) guards it.

DONE WHEN: teacher-forced: verifier logits at every depth EQUAL the sequential engine's logits for the same prefix (the definitional test of Tier-1 equivalence); its own overflow selftest row; bench (seq-16 pass vs 15 sequential steps) recorded per SKU.

title: [3B] Prompt partial evaluation + voice-cache prefix KV
description:
[3B] Prompt partial evaluation + .ftvoice-cache prefix KV reuse.

WHAT: skip recomputing the voice-dependent, target-text-INDEPENDENT prompt prefix on every utterance: precompute static prompt embeddings + verified static-prefix KV at enrollment (or first use), store in .ftvoice-cache keyed by {voice_recipe_hash, model_hash, prompt_builder_version, streaming_mode, quant_recipe, math_mode, engine_abi}; at synthesis, load + validate the key tuple, then prefill only the target-dependent suffix.

THE SAFETY RULE (OQ-10 is the authority): cache ONLY the maximal prefix PROVEN independent of target text — the official ICL prompt interleaves reference text, target text, reference codec tokens, and mode-dependent alignment, and streaming/non-streaming prompts differ structurally; caching one target-dependent position silently corrupts synthesis. All source primitives stay in the portable .ftvoice so caches regenerate after ANY bump (a cache is an optimization, never the only copy).

DONE WHEN: prompt-cache == full-prefill metamorphic gate green (bit-identical KV + identical downstream tokens in strict mode); TTFA improvement measured per voice; key-tuple invalidation tests; cold-vs-warm TTFA both reported honestly.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text:
[from OQ-10, AzureThrush] PREFIX VERDICT — the cacheable prefix is much smaller than 'cache the voice prompt' implies. Full proof + line citations: docs/truth-pack/OQ10_ICL_PROMPT_STRUCTURE.md §5. Executable model: scripts/oq10_prompt_shapes.py.

Maximal target-text-INDEPENDENT prefix, by mode (H = fixed header, 7 or 9 positions; T2 = 1 + ref_frames):
  ICL x streaming      : H + min(T2, |ref_id|)   -- includes codec_bos + the first min(T2,|ref_id|)-1 REFERENCE CODEC FRAMES
  ICL x non-streaming  : H + |ref_id|            -- ZERO reference codec frames are cacheable
  x-vector x either    : H                       -- header only, 7-9 positions

WHY the ref codec frames mostly fall outside: in streaming mode the codec stream is summed ELEMENTWISE with the text stream, so any position past |ref_id| carries target text; in non-streaming mode the codec block is CONCATENATED AFTER the target text, so under the causal mask its KV depends on the target text.

ACTIONS FOR THIS BEAD:
1. Do NOT ship a prefix-KV section for x-vector modes -- 7-9 positions is not worth the format surface. The reusable x-vector artifact is the speaker embedding, not KV.
2. Cache key MUST include (language_id, speaker_embed, ref_id token ids, ref_code, non_streaming_mode) on top of plan §6.7's tuple. language_id and speaker_embed live INSIDE the header H (modeling_qwen3_tts.py:2136-2172), so they invalidate even the header -- easy to miss because they read like runtime options.
3. Free two-level win: H is built identically in all four modes (M:2126-2186 precedes every branch), so header KV is shareable across streaming modes for a given (language, speaker). Only the ICL block needs a per-mode entry.
4. Representative sizes from scripts/oq10_prompt_shapes.py: 3s ref / 12-token ref text / 40-token target -> ICL streaming caches 21 of 48 prompt positions (44%); ICL non-streaming caches 21 of 101 (21%). Bound your expected TTFA win by these, not by the whole prompt.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text:
[from OQ-8, AzureThrush] Two codec behaviours found while tracing the audio output path for the watermark question. Neither is in the plan; both affect codec parity. Detail: docs/truth-pack/OQ8_WATERMARKING.md §3.

1. REFERENCE FRAMES ARE PREPENDED BEFORE DECODE, THEN CUT FROM THE AUDIO (inference/qwen3_tts_model.py:613-631):
     codes_for_decode = cat([ref_code, generated_codes])
     wav = speech_tokenizer.decode(codes_for_decode)
     cut = int(ref_len / total_len * wav.shape[0]);  return wav[cut:]
   In ICL mode the reference's own codec frames are decoded TOGETHER with the generated frames and the audio prefix is discarded. The reference audio is never returned but it IS computed -- it primes the causal decoder's ring-buffer state so generated speech starts with a warmed receptive field instead of zeros.
   => Decoding only the generated codes is NOT equivalent; the onset will differ. Our engine must either replay the reference decode and discard, or precompute the primed ring-buffer state into .ftvoice-cache (better -- removes ref decode from the TTFA path). Either way it must be PROVEN equivalent, not assumed. Also: the streaming==batch gate must fix this warm-up convention on both sides or it fails for unrelated reasons. TTFA cost if done naively: an extra ref_frames of codec decode (~38 for a 3s reference).

2. THE CUT IS A FLOAT RATIO, NOT A FRAME COUNT. Since decode() trims to exactly n_frames * decode_upsample_rate (tokenizer_12hz/modeling_qwen3_tts_tokenizer_v2.py:1013,1018), the cut is algebraically ref_len * upsample_rate, but it is implemented as float multiply-and-truncate. Port it as exact integer ref_len * upsample_rate and record the equivalence -- otherwise it is a one-sample offset that is miserable to debug in a parity test.

Also confirmed for codec parity: decode() is RVQ lookup -> decoder.chunked_decode -> length trim, and NOTHING else. No postprocessing stage exists, so any systematic waveform difference we see is our bug, not an unported stage.

title: [OQ-5b] Numeric oracle trace of one microdecoder frame (per-depth inputs/outputs)
design:
Numeric confirmation of the OQ-5 Tier-1 verdict, which was settled STATICALLY (line-level reading of the pinned source) in docs/truth-pack/OQ5_MICRODECODER_WIRING.md.

WHAT: with the oracle stood up, capture a real single-frame trace of the microdecoder: for each of the 16 sequence positions, the input vector provenance, the hidden state, and the 15 head logits. Splitting it keeps the Tier-1 verdict usable now without presenting an unmet criterion as met.

description:

(a) FIXED in e21b617 — 'cancel-in-progress: true' applied to main, so every run was killed by the next commit (8 consecutive cancellations observed 2026-08-06). Now scoped to pull_request only.

(b) OPEN — runner capacity. Run 31074936630 sat queued for 10h16m before any job started. Check Actions minutes / billing / spending limits on the Dicklesworthstone org, or whether hosted runners are available for this repo at all.

DONE WHEN: 'gh run list' shows a main run whose 'gate (scripts/check.sh)' job concluded (success or failure — either proves the pipeline executes); the sibling-checkout and /dp/frankentorch symlink steps are confirmed working on a real runner; and it is settled whether SIBLING_REPO_TOKEN is needed (depends on whether Dicklesworthstone/frankentorch is private — the workflow falls back to github.token, which only works while it is public).

This is the last unobserved piece of frankentts-p0-ci-083; everything else in that bead is verified.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text:
DIAGNOSIS 2026-08-06 (cc_4) — hypothesis (b) 'runner capacity' is WRONG; corrected below. Fix pushed in d54a59d.

WHAT THE EVIDENCE SHOWS. Run 31074936630 (05:42:37Z) DID get runners: six of its seven jobs started within one second of the push, including 'gate (scripts/check.sh)'. All six were then cancelled at 05:44:22Z by the pre-e21b617 cancel-in-progress policy. Its seventh job, 'advisory cross-check summary' (needs: cross, if: always(), so still scheduled after a cancellation), was created at 05:44:23Z and stuck in 'queued' — never assigned a runner, never completed. So runners were available; capacity was not the blocker.

WHY EVERYTHING SINCE THEN DIED. That zombie job kept run 31074936630 alive, holding concurrency group ci-refs/heads/main for 11+ hours. Every later main run therefore sat in status 'pending' (blocked on the group, zero jobs ever created), and GitHub keeps at most ONE pending run per group — so each new push cancelled the previously queued one. Measured: run 31120416091 queued 16:36:20Z, cancelled 16:47:19Z, the same second run 31121042924 was created. Same pattern for 31121601716 -> 31122430330. Six consecutive main runs, zero jobs each.

WHY e21b617 DID NOT FIX IT. cancel-in-progress governs only IN-PROGRESS runs. These runs were never in progress — they were pending. Setting it false changed nothing for them.

THE ZOMBIE CANNOT BE CLEARED FROM THIS SIDE. Both POST /actions/runs/31074936630/cancel and .../force-cancel return HTTP 502 Server Error, retried 4x. It is wedged on GitHub's side. It should age out at GitHub's 24h queue limit (~2026-08-07 05:42Z); if it does not, it needs GitHub support and only the account owner can escalate.

FIX (d54a59d), which routes around the zombie rather than waiting on it:
- concurrency group for push events keys on github.run_id — a group of one, so main runs are never coalesced, never superseded, and cannot be blocked by a wedged neighbour. Pull requests keep the shared cancelling group, where coalescing actually saves runner time.
- cross-summary: 'if: !cancelled()' instead of 'always()', plus timeout-minutes: 5, so a cancelled run can never again leave a summary job queued forever.

CONFIRMED WORKING: run 31123043545 (the fix's own push) reached status 'queued' with all 6 jobs created, instead of 'pending' with zero — the group no longer blocks it. Previous run 31122430330 was NOT cancelled by this push, confirming the groups are now separate.

SIBLING_REPO_TOKEN QUESTION — SETTLED: Dicklesworthstone/frankentorch is PUBLIC (verified via API), so the workflow's github.token fallback is correct and no SIBLING_REPO_TOKEN is needed. This stops being true the moment that repo goes private.

STILL OPEN: no job has yet been ASSIGNED a runner on 31123043545 (~6 min queued and counting), where the 05:42Z run got them in one second. That may be ordinary GitHub load or a real capacity limit; it is now observable in isolation because the concurrency blocker is gone. The bead stays open until a 'gate' job actually concludes.

title: [OQ-1] LICENSE verbatim + NOTICE obligations
description:
[OQ-1] Verify LICENSE verbatim + NOTICE obligations at the pinned revision.

QUESTION: is the model truly Apache-2.0, weights included, at the pinned revision? Any separate weights-license nuance? Exact NOTICE/attribution obligations for redistributing our quantized .fttsq derivative?

WHY: the entire artifact-distribution story (publishing converted weights, embedding license_notice in .fttsq headers, --version attribution) is legal only if this checks out. [REPORTED] Apache-2.0 from the model-selection research; primary-source verification required before ANY artifact publishing.

BLOCKS: artifact publishing (.fttsq format bead embeds the notice; the release epic's checklist). Does NOT block kernel work (per-component gating).

DONE WHEN: LICENSE file quoted verbatim in docs/truth-pack/; a one-paragraph legal-obligations note (what we must ship where); disposition recorded in the OQ register.
close_reason: Verified against pinned bytes -> docs/LICENSE_AND_ATTRIBUTION.md. Plan 2.2 License [REPORTED] -> [VERIFIED]. gh/LICENSE is canonical Apache-2.0 verbatim (201 lines, all 9 sections once each, sole deviation is the sanctioned appendix copyright substitution 'Copyright 2026 Alibaba Cloud'); no added restrictions found. Weights: model-card frontmatter apache-2.0, no additional terms in the body. Probed at the PINNED revisions: gh LICENSE 200 and byte-identical to our snapshot (independent re-verification of the truth pack), gh NOTICE 404, hf LICENSE 404, hf NOTICE 404 -> Apache sec 4(d) is MOOT and the weights license is knowingly model-card-only. Derivative obligations resolved with a ready-to-embed license_notice string handed to p2-fttsq-format-wsa; 4(b) 'state your changes' flagged as the one condition needing engineering attention. Artifact publishing is legally clear to proceed.

title: [OQ-10] ICL prompt structure x streaming + target-independent prefix
description:
[OQ-10] ICL prompt structure per (clone mode x streaming mode) + the maximal target-text-independent prefix.

QUESTION: the official ICL prompt interleaves reference text, target text, reference codec tokens, and mode-dependent alignment; streaming and non-streaming prompts differ STRUCTURALLY [SOURCE]. Document the exact template for all four combinations (x-vector/ICL x streaming/non-streaming): special tokens, language tags, ordering, alignment rules. Then determine the MAXIMAL PREFIX PROVABLY INDEPENDENT OF THE TARGET TEXT.

WHY: (a) prompt assembly is Contract-A L0 — a one-token error corrupts every downstream gate; (b) the .ftvoice-cache design caches static prompt embeddings + verified static-prefix KV, and caching anything target-dependent silently corrupts synthesis — plan v2 explicitly demoted "cached voice-prompt KV" from assumed-easy to proven-prefix-only on the strength of this structure; (c) TTFA optimization (prompt partial evaluation) depends on the same analysis.

DONE WHEN: all four templates documented with line citations + worked examples; the independent-prefix proof written down (which positions can never attend to target text and why); .ftvoice-cache bead consumes the verdict.
notes: AzureThrush 2026-08-06: ALL exit criteria met. (1) four templates documented with line citations -> docs/truth-pack/OQ10_ICL_PROMPT_STRUCTURE.md §1-§3; (2) worked example token-exact §7; (3) independent-prefix proof §5 (position-by-position, causal-mask argument); (4) verdict consumed by k-voice-cache-i4t, p4-ftvoice-format-x0p (comments). Executable acceptance gate scripts/oq10_prompt_shapes.py, negative-controlled 3/3. The earlier 'inferred, not measured' gap on the 3/5/2 wrapper tokenization is CLOSED: measured against pinned tokenizer bytes with the pinned oracle (transformers 4.57.3, fix_mistral_regex=True) across 7 text classes incl. CJK/empty/emoji. Also resolved cc_1's LEAD 1 (tts_text_bos_single unused) and LEAD 2 (voice-clone default = streaming).
close_reason: All four (clone mode x streaming mode) ICL prompt templates documented with line citations; target-independent prefix proved position-by-position (H + min(T2,|ref_id|) for ICL, H for x-vector -- reference codec frames are largely NOT cacheable, confirming and quantifying plan §6.7's demotion); token-exact worked example; verdict propagated to k-voice-cache-i4t and p4-ftvoice-format-x0p. Executable acceptance gate scripts/oq10_prompt_shapes.py (negative-controlled). Wrapper tokenization measured against the pinned oracle, not inferred.

comments.author: cc_1
comments.text:
TRUTH PACK (frankentts-t-pin-sources-b2u) — pinned entrypoints + two concrete leads.

C-1 IS LOAD-BEARING HERE: the text stream is not a prefill-only prefix. Per frame the talker input is
sum(16 code embeddings) + trailing_text_hidden[:, generation_step] (or tts_pad_embed once exhausted)
— modeling_qwen3_tts.py:1671-1692. So 'the ICL prompt' splits into a prefill part and a per-frame
trailing-text stream; the target-independent-prefix idea in this bead's title must be evaluated
against THAT structure, not against a flat prefix.

LEAD 1: tokenizer_config.json defines 151674 <tts_text_bos_single> IN ADDITION to 151672
<tts_text_bos>. config.json names only the latter. A distinct 'single' bos strongly suggests different
prompt assembly for single-segment vs multi-segment input — resolve it here.
LEAD 2: qwen_tts/inference/qwen3_tts_model.py has two entrypoints with non_streaming_mode defaulting
differently (:478 False, :642 True); ICL prompt structure x streaming mode is exactly this bead's
scope. Cross-ref frankentts-oq14-streaming-internals-pqz.

Snapshotted and hashed for offline reading:
  snapshots/gh/qwen_tts/inference/qwen3_tts_model.py
  snapshots/gh/qwen_tts/core/models/processing_qwen3_tts.py
  snapshots/gh/examples/test_model_12hz_base.py   (the Base-checkpoint cloning entrypoint)
  snapshots/hf/README.md                          (model card's voice-clone usage snippet)
Detail: docs/truth-pack/FACT_DISPOSITIONS.md (C-1)

comments.author: cc_1
comments.text:
OQ-11 hand-off (frankentts-oq11-tokenizer-p94) — prompt assembly is ENTIRELY yours.

Confirmed from tokenizer_config.json + the pinned oracle: the tokenizer adds NO BOS and NO EOS
(add_bos_token false, bos_token null). Qwen3TTSProcessor does no normalization and no wrapping —
it forwards text to the tokenizer with only padding=False, padding_side='left'. So every special
token in the prompt is placed by the CALLER, and reconstructing that placement is OQ-10's job.

Verified special-token behavior that helps you: special tokens appearing as LITERAL TEXT are matched
to their single ids (<|im_start|> -> 151644, <tts_text_bos> -> 151672, <tts_text_bos_single> ->
151674). split_special_tokens is false. So you can probe prompt shapes by round-tripping literal
strings. A lookalike (<|not_a_real_token|>) is NOT matched and splits into 8 ordinary tokens.

The 151674 <tts_text_bos_single> lead I flagged earlier now has sharper context: config.json names
only tts_bos_token_id 151672, and 151673 is <tts_text_eod> (note 'eod', not 'eos'). A distinct
'_single' BOS plus an 'end of document' EOS points at multi-segment vs single-segment prompt
assembly — likely tied to the long-form chunking in OQ-6.

Reference ids for any prompt string you need to verify:
docs/truth-pack/tokenizer/tokenizer_conformance.json; regenerate with
scripts/gen_tokenizer_conformance.py. Full detail: docs/truth-pack/tokenizer/OQ11_TOKENIZER.md

comments.author: cc_11
comments.text:
[from OQ-14 -- runtime half of the ICL prompt structure, docs/QWEN3_TTS_STREAMING_CONTRACT.md sec 2]
generate_icl_prompt (modeling_qwen3_tts.py:1968-2019) forks on non_streaming_mode:
 * True (2002-2013): text and codec CONCATENATED -- [text_embed + codec_pad_id] ++ [codec_embed +
   tts_pad]; all text lands in prefill; trailing_text_hidden = tts_pad_embed (scalar).
 * False (2014-2019): text and codec SUMMED position-wise over the overlap. If text_lens > codec_lens
   the prefill takes text_embed[:, :codec_lens] and the REMAINDER becomes trailing_text_hidden; if
   shorter, text is right-padded with tts_pad_embed.
Reference codec embedding (1984-1998): group 0 via talker input embeddings, groups 1-15 via
code_predictor per-depth embeddings [i-1], summed, prefixed with codec_bos_id 2149.
TRAP for your target-text-independent-prefix analysis: voice clone defaults to
non_streaming_mode=FALSE (inference/qwen3_tts_model.py:478), so the DEFAULT cloning geometry is the
summed/streamed one where the prefix depends on codec_lens vs text_lens -- the maximal
target-text-independent prefix is mode-dependent and differs between the two.

title: [OQ-11] Tokenizer identity + upstream normalization (verbatim mode)
description:
[OQ-11] Text tokenizer identity + upstream normalization responsibilities.

QUESTION: which tokenizer files/algorithm exactly (Qwen BPE expected; vocab 151,936)? What text normalization does the OFFICIAL Python stack perform before tokenization (if any), vs what the model handles internally? (Upstream advertises robustness to noisy text — aggressive silent rewriting on our side would be a semantic divergence.)

WHY: token-id-exact encoding is the FIRST rung of Contract A — a tokenizer mismatch corrupts every downstream gate, so this resolves before any decoder parity work. The answer defines our "verbatim" normalization mode (exact upstream behavior = the conformance path and default); "conservative" and "locale-aware" modes are OUR additions layered on top with an emitted normalization trace.

DONE WHEN: tokenizer files pinned + hashed; the upstream preprocessing pipeline documented line-by-line; a token-id conformance corpus (diverse Unicode, CJK, numbers, code, specials) frozen with reference id sequences.
close_reason: OQ-11 resolved. Identity: byte-level BPE (Qwen2Tokenizer/Fast) from vocab.json+merges.txt, no tokenizer.json; slow==fast on all 92 cases. Normalization: exactly Unicode NFC, applied inside the tokenizer (tokenization_qwen2.py:338 / backend NFC()), NOT NFKC (proven with 4 compatibility probes); processor does none. Found and characterized the fix_mistral_regex trap: every official entrypoint swaps in Mistral's pre-tokenizer regex (qwen3_tts_model.py:118), diverging on 6/92 cases confined to case-boundary splitting and complex-script segmentation; ordinary prose in all 10 languages, contractions, numbers, URLs and CJK are identical. 92-case corpus frozen with reference ids from the pinned oracle (transformers 4.57.3), 6 normalization invariants asserted as a gate. DISC entry deliberately deferred to frankentts-p1-tokenizer-2uf (no implementation, no measured impact, no kill switch yet). Deliverables: docs/truth-pack/tokenizer/OQ11_TOKENIZER.md, tokenizer_conformance.json, scripts/gen_tokenizer_conformance.py.

comments.author: cc_1
comments.text:

errors, split_special_tokens, model_max_length.

33 added special tokens, ids 151643-151675. TTS-relevant ones, several NOT named in config.json:
  151643 <|endoftext|> (pad)   151644 <|im_start|>   151645 <|im_end|>
  151669 <|audio_start|>       151670 <|audio_end|>
  151671 <tts_pad>             151672 <tts_text_bos>  151673 <tts_text_eod>
  151674 <tts_text_bos_single>  151675 <|audio_pad|>

title: [OQ-12] Canonical conformance decoder + L5 fork decision
description:
[OQ-12] Define the canonical conformance decoder + production sampler contract (a DESIGN DECISION, not fact-finding — the defaults are known).

KNOWN [SOURCE]: talker samples at T=0.9/top_k=50/top_p=1.0/repetition_penalty=1.05; residual predictor at T=0.9/top_k=50/top_p=1.0. The reference SAMPLES AT BOTH LEVELS — which is why one conformance ladder cannot serve two masters (Contract A/B split).

DECIDE: (a) the canonical conformance decoder = greedy/argmax at both levels — IS GREEDY AUDIO QUALITY-VIABLE? Run it and listen. (b) The pre-committed L5 fork: if greedy audio is viable, L5 = perceptual goldens + metrics over greedy audio; if NOT, L5 = exactness over codec-fixed audio (decode of frozen token streams) and the perceptual duty transfers wholly to Contract B. Agents never invent tolerances to bridge the branches. (c) The production sampler contract: our own seeded RNG (documented DISC — we replicate the distribution contract, never torch's RNG stream), repetition-penalty semantics ported exactly.

DONE WHEN: fork resolved with listening evidence; canonical decoder implemented in the fixture generator; sampler contract documented in the spec; the DISC entry for RNG divergence filed.
notes:

(c) production sampler contract RESOLVED + canonical conformance decoder DEFINED -> docs/truth-pack/OQ12_SAMPLER_CONTRACT.md; propagated to p1-sampler-f1e, oq6, oq2, oq15. Key result: canonical greedy is NOT bare argmax -- logits PROCESSORS (rep_penalty 1.05, min_new_tokens 2, suppress_tokens) always apply even at do_sample=False; only WARPERS are gated. And argmax is warper-invariant, so the canonical decoder is fully defined TODAY without resolving the greedy-audio fork.

NOT RESOLVED: (a) is greedy audio quality-viable -- requires generated audio + listening panel; no torch and no weights on this host. (b) the L5 fork is strictly downstream of (a). DELIBERATELY NOT FILED: the DISC-NNN for RNG divergence -- docs/DISCREPANCIES.md's schema requires measured_impact and explicitly forbids unmeasured records; obligation carried by p1-sampler-f1e. Bead exit criteria and the ledger contract conflict here; ledger wins.

close_reason: Definition half resolved into docs/CANONICAL_DECODER_AND_SAMPLER.md; oracle-gated half carried by frankentts-ri0 [OQ-12b] with a predeclared selection criterion, both L5 branches pre-committed, and an auto-reopen condition on this bead if the verdict contradicts the definition. Canonical decoder defined as argmax at both levels with the reference's non-warper processors applied (talker: rep penalty 1.05 + min_new_tokens=2 EOS mask + suppress_tokens; microdecoder: raw argmax, fixed 15 steps) and no RNG. Production sampler contract fully specified: per-level order (the two levels have DIFFERENT stacks), sign-dependent repetition penalty over the group-0 history only, our-RNG distribution-contract scoping. Two findings with reach: suppress_tokens masks 2048-3071 except EOS so the talker's support is exactly {0..2047} u {2150} (independently confirming OQ-7's identity ID map), and the whole sampler contract is defined by pinned transformers 4.57.3 since Qwen ships no custom logits processors. p1-sampler-f1e fully unblocked. comments.author: cc_11
comments.text:
[RESOLVED on the definition half -> docs/CANONICAL_DECODER_AND_SAMPLER.md]

Picked this up per FuchsiaMouse's final call: it had sat ~3h with zero commits and AzureThrush shows
no commits in the recent window. Reassigned to cc_11 rather than leaving it held silently.

(a) CANONICAL CONFORMANCE DECODER = argmax at BOTH levels with the reference's NON-WARPER logits
processors still applied, and no RNG. Talker: argmax after repetition penalty 1.05, min_new_tokens=2
EOS masking, and the suppress_tokens mask. Microdecoder: argmax over raw per-depth head logits (the
reference passes it no penalty, no mask, no eos). Warpers are excluded on purpose -- temperature is a
monotone positive scale and top-k/top-p are truncations, so none can change an argmax; including them
would be harmless but would misrepresent the contract. Non-warper processors are included because
they change WHICH TOKEN WINS.

KEY FINDING: the two levels have DIFFERENT processor stacks (talker gets rep penalty + suppress +
eos + min_new_tokens; microdecoder gets none of them). That is the mechanical reason one ladder
cannot serve two masters.

KEY FINDING: suppress_tokens masks ids 2048..3071 except EOS 2150 (modeling:2059-2063), so the
talker's effective support is exactly {0..2047} u {2150}. This independently confirms OQ-7's
identity ID map, and means a port that omits the mask will occasionally emit a control id into
group 0 and hand the codec an out-of-range code. Also min_new_tokens=2: EOS is unreachable for the
first two frames.

(c) PRODUCTION SAMPLER CONTRACT: exact per-level order documented (non-commutative at every stage),
sign-dependent repetition-penalty formula, penalty applied over the GROUP-0 history only, and our-RNG
scoping (replicate the distribution, never torch's stream; determinism scoped as build+ISA+sampler
version+seed+artifact; token agreement under sampling is a diagnostic, not a gate). The DISC entry is
owed when the divergence can be MEASURED at Phase-1 sampler landing -- filing one now with an
unmeasured impact is the counterfeit evidence DISCREPANCIES.md forbids at seed time.
NOTE: there are no custom logits processors anywhere in the Qwen stack, so the whole contract is
defined by pinned transformers 4.57.3 -- that pin is now part of the sampler contract and a change to
it must re-run L3. Filed against oq15.

(b) L5 FORK: not guessable without listening. Split to frankentts-ri0 [OQ-12b] with a PREDECLARED
selection criterion and both branches pre-committed, plus an auto-reopen condition on this bead if
the verdict contradicts the definition itself. L0-L4 are unaffected by the branch, so kernel work
proceeds against L4 today.

Closing on the definition half: that is what the dependents need. p1-sampler-f1e is fully unblocked
(contract handed over in a comment); v-prod-harness-t96 has its claim scoping and awaits only the
branch.

title: [OQ-13] GGML kept-high-precision set (validate quant recipe)
description:
[OQ-13] Enumerate the GGML conversion's exact kept-high-precision tensor set.

QUESTION: the upstream GGML maintainer's converged policy is "Q8 default, keep RVQ codebooks, norms, speaker-encoder output layers, and awkward convolution kernels at higher precision." Enumerate the EXACT tensor list they keep high (dump the community GGUF's per-tensor types) and reconcile against OUR planned recipe (int8 talker+microdecoder GEMMs; high-precision norms/logits-boundaries/RVQ codebooks/speaker path; codec Q8).

WHY: this is the closest thing to prior-art validation our quantization recipe has. Any tensor THEY keep high that WE planned to quantize is OUR risk to retire by measurement (kill-switch + listening gate), never assumed safe. Mirrors the sibling project's lesson where the community quant's module count did not reconcile with the naive census and the difference was load-bearing.

close_reason:
Community GGML kept-high-precision set enumerated FROM THE ACTUAL GGUF BYTES (Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF @ e0f336a -- the 993 MB talker artifact plan §2.2 already cited, plus the matching codec GGUF), via scripts/oq13_gguf_tensor_types.py which reads only the GGUF header over HTTP Range. Reconciliation table committed: docs/truth-pack/OQ13_GGML_QUANT_RECONCILIATION.md §3.

TWO DIVERGENCES WHERE THEY ARE STRICTER THAN US, both filed as explicit Phase-2 risks: (R1, HIGH) 'codec Q8' is wrong as stated -- ALL genuine convolutions stay F16 and ALL Snake activation params stay F32; only the codec's transformer blocks and 1x1 pointwise convs are Q8 -> filed on p2-codec-q8-3vw with a recommendation to default the conv stack to F16 and gate conv-Q8 separately. (R2, LOW) they keep the ENTIRE speaker encoder high, not just output layers -> filed on p2-int8-talker-micro-upg.

Also flagged a terminology fix (§3.1): 'acoustic codebooks' must not be read as covering the microdecoder's per-depth input embeddings -- three distinct objects, not two. title: [OQ-14] Official streaming internals (first packet, flush, packets)
description:
[OQ-14] Official streaming internals: first-packet path, flush behavior, prompt differences.

QUESTION: how does the official streaming mode actually work — first-packet latency path, packet assembly (the measured system groups 4 frames into 320 ms packets to avoid scheduling overhead), flush/finalization behavior at utterance end, and the structural prompt differences vs non-streaming (overlaps OQ-10; this bead owns the RUNTIME semantics)?

WHY: G8 makes packet size an execution-policy parameter (1/2/4/auto) — but our packet policies must be able to reproduce the official behavior exactly in strict mode (conformance packetization), and TTFA benchmarking must compare like-for-like first-packet paths. Flush semantics also decide the partial-WAV finalization contract in the streaming-failure gates.

DONE WHEN: streaming runtime semantics documented with line citations; strict-mode packetization defined; TTFA measurement protocol pinned to the official first-packet path.
close_reason: Resolved into docs/QWEN3_TTS_STREAMING_CONTRACT.md. Headline: the released code has NO streaming generation -- upstream states verbatim (inference:514-515) that non_streaming_mode only simulates streaming TEXT INPUT; there is no packet assembly, no first-packet path, no flush. The 4-frame/320ms packetization and the 97ms first-packet latency are PAPER claims about an internal serving system that was not open-sourced, so the bead's 'reproduce official packetization exactly' criterion is unsatisfiable as written -- strict mode is DEFINED from the paper (4 frames / 7680 samples) and validated against streaming==batch instead. Documented both prompt geometries per clone path with line citations, plus the entrypoint-default trap (voice clone defaults to streaming-simulated, the other two do not). TTFA baseline pinned to our exact row (12Hz-0.6B: 93+4=97ms, LM TPP 19ms, RTF 0.288) with NO ADMISSIBLE RATIO recorded -- the paper names no hardware. Findings propagated to 3 dependent beads; plan 2.7 retag [SOURCE]->[SOURCE, paper] filed.

comments.author: cc_11
comments.text:
[OQ-14 RESOLVED -> docs/QWEN3_TTS_STREAMING_CONTRACT.md]

1. THERE IS NO STREAMING GENERATION IN THE RELEASED CODE. Upstream says so itself, verbatim at
   inference/qwen3_tts_model.py:514-515 (repeated at 656-657, 754-755): 'this option currently only
   simulates streaming text INPUT when set to false, rather than enabling true streaming input or
   streaming generation.' Confirmed by search: no generator/iterator/callback, no packet assembly, no
   flush/finalization, no incremental codec invocation. Generation runs to completion and the codec
   then decodes everything in one chunked_decode call.
   => The bead's acceptance criterion 'reproduce the official packetization exactly in strict mode'
   is UNSATISFIABLE as written -- there is no released packetization to reproduce. Strict mode must
   be DEFINED from the paper and validated against the streaming==batch invariant instead. Recorded,
   not papered over.

2. PLAN CORRECTION: 2.7's '4 frames / 320 ms packet' is a PAPER claim describing an internal serving
   system that was not open-sourced. Retag [SOURCE] -> [SOURCE, paper].

3. non_streaming_mode is a PROMPT-CONSTRUCTION switch only, with two distinct geometries per clone
   path (ICL: modeling:2002-2019; x-vector: modeling:2203-2232). True -> all text in prefill,
   trailing_text_hidden = tts_pad (pad fallback from frame 0). False -> text summed position-wise
   with codec over the overlap and the remainder metered in at ONE HIDDEN PER FRAME (12.5 tokens/s).
   Sharp edge: if text is longer than the frames generated, the TAIL OF THE TEXT IS NEVER SEEN.
   TRAP: the default differs by entrypoint -- voice clone defaults to non_streaming_mode=FALSE
   (inference:478), i.e. streaming-simulated is the default on the cloning path we care most about,
   while voice design and custom voice default to True (642, 738). Any A/B not holding this constant
   compares two different prompt geometries and is invalid. Prefill cost differs by orders of
   magnitude, so TTFA is only comparable within a mode.

4. TTFA BASELINE PINNED (paper sec 4 efficiency table, our exact row): Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B at
   concurrency 1 = LM TTFP 93 ms + tokenizer decode 4 ms = First-Packet Latency 97 ms; LM TPP 19 ms;
   RTF 0.288. The famous '97 ms' IS our model (the 25Hz variants are 138-150 ms) -- worth pinning
   since the 25Hz rows sit directly above it in the same table.
   BUT: NO ADMISSIBLE RATIO against it. The paper measured 'on our internal vLLM engine (vLLM V0
   backend) on a single typical computational resource' -- NO HARDWARE IS NAMED. Per plan 10.6 and
   the claim taxonomy, any 'we beat/approach 97 ms' claim is inadmissible. It is usable only as a
   documented upstream claim and as evidence that the codec's share of first-packet latency is small
   (4 of 97 ms), consistent with OQ-7's finding that codec streaming state is only a few MB.

5. Strict-mode packetization DEFINED: 1 packet = 4 frames = 320 ms = 7680 samples @ 24 kHz. Validated
   by streaming==batch, not by imitation. Note our streaming is bit-identical to our offline in BOTH
   regimes, but diverges from the official chunked_decode beyond 300 frames (that is OQ-7's DISC row,
   not a regression). Flush semantics are OURS by necessity -- tied to the EOS rule and the
   truncation-reporting requirement from OQ-6.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: [from OQ-8, AzureThrush] Relevant to first-packet/TTFA: in ICL mode the official path PREPENDS the reference codec frames to the generated codes, decodes them together, and cuts the reference audio off afterwards (inference/qwen3_tts_model.py:613-631). So the reference decode is on the naive first-audio path (~38 frames for a 3s ref) and it primes the causal decoder's ring buffer -- decoding generated codes alone is not equivalent. Caching the primed state is the fix. See docs/truth-pack/OQ8_WATERMARKING.md §3.1.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text:
[from OQ-8, AzureThrush] Two codec behaviours found while tracing the audio output path for the watermark question. Neither is in the plan; both affect codec parity. Detail: docs/truth-pack/OQ8_WATERMARKING.md §3.

1. REFERENCE FRAMES ARE PREPENDED BEFORE DECODE, THEN CUT FROM THE AUDIO (inference/qwen3_tts_model.py:613-631):
     codes_for_decode = cat([ref_code, generated_codes])
     wav = speech_tokenizer.decode(codes_for_decode)
     cut = int(ref_len / total_len * wav.shape[0]);  return wav[cut:]
   In ICL mode the reference's own codec frames are decoded TOGETHER with the generated frames and the audio prefix is discarded. The reference audio is never returned but it IS computed -- it primes the causal decoder's ring-buffer state so generated speech starts with a warmed receptive field instead of zeros.
   => Decoding only the generated codes is NOT equivalent; the onset will differ. Our engine must either replay the reference decode and discard, or precompute the primed ring-buffer state into .ftvoice-cache (better -- removes ref decode from the TTFA path). Either way it must be PROVEN equivalent, not assumed. Also: the streaming==batch gate must fix this warm-up convention on both sides or it fails for unrelated reasons. TTFA cost if done naively: an extra ref_frames of codec decode (~38 for a 3s reference).

2. THE CUT IS A FLOAT RATIO, NOT A FRAME COUNT. Since decode() trims to exactly n_frames * decode_upsample_rate (tokenizer_12hz/modeling_qwen3_tts_tokenizer_v2.py:1013,1018), the cut is algebraically ref_len * upsample_rate, but it is implemented as float multiply-and-truncate. Port it as exact integer ref_len * upsample_rate and record the equivalence -- otherwise it is a one-sample offset that is miserable to debug in a parity test.

Also confirmed for codec parity: decode() is RVQ lookup -> decoder.chunked_decode -> length trim, and NOTHING else. No postprocessing stage exists, so any systematic waveform difference we see is our bug, not an unported stage.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text:
[from OQ-13, AzureThrush] Codec architecture facts read straight off the community GGUF tensor table (qwen-tokenizer-12hz-Q8_0.gguf) -- free evidence for your bead, independent of the Python source. Detail: docs/truth-pack/OQ13_GGML_QUANT_RECONCILIATION.md §2.3.

1. SEMANTIC/ACOUSTIC ID MAPPING IS EXPLICIT IN THE TENSOR NAMES: encoder has vq_semantic (1 codebook) + vq_acoustic (15); decoder mirrors with vq_first (1) + vq_rest (15). => CODE GROUP 0 IS SEMANTIC, GROUPS 1-15 ARE ACOUSTIC, lining up exactly with the talker predicting group 0 and the microdecoder the other 15.
2. RVQ OPERATES IN A 256-d PROJECTED SPACE, not 512: codebooks are 256x2048 with 1x512x256 input and 1x256x512 output projections. Plan §2.7 does not state this.
3. THE DECODER IS BIGVGAN-STYLE WITH SNAKE ACTIVATIONS, not a plain conv stack: 58 F32 snake.alpha/snake.beta and res.N.act1/act2.alpha/beta tensors. Channel ladder 1536 -> 768 -> 384 -> 192 -> 96 -> 1; transposed-conv kernels 16, 10, 8, 6 = 2x stride for strides 8, 5, 4, 3 -- confirming plan §2.7's upsample [8,5,4,3] FROM THE WEIGHTS.
4. tok_dec.pre_tfm = 8 layers, hidden 512, ffn 1024 (matches plan §2.7). tok_enc.blk = 8 layers, hidden 512, ffn 2048 -- encoder and decoder MLP widths DIFFER.
5. KERNEL WE HAVE NOT PLANNED FOR: Snake activation is transcendental-heavy and per-channel parameterised, sitting on the codec hot path. This is exactly plan §7.2's 'vectorized polynomial transcendental' exception -- flag it for the codec kernel bead.

title: [P0] CLI skeleton (two shims, exit codes, profiles, stateless)
description:

WHAT: ftts-cli with pub fn cli_main() -> ExitCode in its lib; two byte-equivalent one-line [[bin]] shims (crates/ftts-cli/src/main.rs = franken_tts bin; crates/ftts-cli/src/bin/ftts.rs = ftts bin; each fn main() { ftts_cli::cli_main() }-shaped; explicit [[bin]] tables, each pointing at ITS OWN file — never the same path twice, which trips cargo's multiple-build-targets warning). Subcommand stubs: say (WAV out or --stream raw PCM-on-stdout/events-on-stderr), enroll, voice inspect, convert, robot schema/health/backends/selftest, doctor. Flags: --profile {interactive,balanced,throughput,strict}, --packet-frames {1,2,4,auto}, --math-mode {strict,fast}, --voice-pack {portable,private,minimal}, --normalize {verbatim,conservative,locale-aware}, --trace DIR, --seed.

TEXT INPUT UX (long-form is a first-class product regime — the CLI must serve it): ftts say accepts text as an argument, from --file PATH, or from stdin (- convention); multi-paragraph documents flow through the long-form path (OQ-6 chunking policy); per-span language overrides + pronunciation-lexicon hooks ride the normalization surface. title: [P0] TtsEngine shell (runtime, cancellation, bounded queues, observer)
description:
[P0] TtsEngine shell: asupersync runtime, cancellation, budgets, bounded queues, SynthesisObserver.

WHAT: ftts-core's engine skeleton per the proven layered pattern: fn main() stays SYNCHRONOUS (clap -> ShutdownController -> sync run() -> exit code); the engine OWNS one asupersync Runtime below main (never spanning the process); public API sync + blocking (TtsEngine::synthesize/enroll); CPU-bound stages via spawn_blocking wrapped in per-stage budget timeouts (FTTS_STAGE_BUDGET_*_MS); a Copy CancellationToken with checkpoint() at every talker-frame boundary (cancellation is cooperative — the token goes INTO closures); ONE bounded stream-queue abstraction for PCM + events (consumer stall parks the producer — backpressure, never unbounded buffering; audio and event channels must not be able to deadlock each other: separate bounded queues, independent shutdown).

SynthesisObserver (G6 made concrete): the caller-owned observer contract — stage timings, frame progress, admission decisions, packet emissions, health events; --trace, robot NDJSON, and the bench harness are all thin consumers of the same hook; no global state, no default persistence.

HARD RULES: never nest a second runtime inside a task; never parallelism under a held lock; exactly one live synthesis fan-out per engine (the Phase-3D batching scheduler later becomes that single owner).

DONE WHEN: empty pipeline runs end-to-end with events + cancellation + budget timeout all demonstrated by tests; many_utterances_without_deadlock watchdog skeleton in place (utterances >> pool; hangs CI on regression).
