title: [P0] Model-gated harness + test observability convention
description:
[P0] Model-gated test harness + THE PROJECT-WIDE TEST OBSERVABILITY CONVENTION.

PART 1 — MODEL-GATED HARNESS: the pattern for everything needing multi-GB weights: tests skip WITH SUCCESS when the model artifact is absent (CI stays green without weights) but the skip is HONEST — receipts record skipped-vs-green distinctly (a skipped ladder is NEVER mistaken for green; XFAIL never SKIP for known divergences). When weights ARE present, prove the NATIVE path actually ran (point any fallback at /nonexistent so silent fallback fails loudly).

PART 2 — THE TEST OBSERVABILITY CONVENTION (inherited by EVERY bead's tests; their "unit tests" DONE-WHEN clauses implicitly include it — this bead is the single authoritative definition so 100+ beads need not repeat it): (a) every test emits STRUCTURED, DETAILED LOGS — on failure a test must localize the problem WITHOUT a debugger rerun: assertion context (expected vs actual with shapes/dtypes/indices), the seam being tested, fixture provenance (which oracle dump, which hash), RNG seeds, tolerance used + its source (the floor artifact), and timing; (b) comparator failures print the FIRST divergent element with its coordinates plus summary stats (max-abs, cosine, count-over-tolerance) — never a bare "assert failed"; (c) e2e scripts log every stage transition with wall-clock + key intermediate hashes (token-stream hash, PCM hash) so a red run pinpoints its stage in seconds; (d) logs are machine-parseable (one JSON object per event where practical) so CI can aggregate failure patterns; (e) test names encode the contract tested (contract_a_l2_talker_layer17_cosine, not test_talker_3). Rust: a shared test-support module in ftts-conformance provides the logging macros/helpers so the convention is one import away.

WHY: the user-facing promise is "we can be sure everything works perfectly after implementation" — that requires failures to be INFORMATIVE, not just detected. This convention is what makes 121 beads' worth of tests debuggable by agents at 3am.

DONE WHEN: harness macros/utilities + logging helpers in ftts-conformance; a demo test shows all three gate states (green-with-model, skip-without-model, loud-failure-on-silent-fallback) AND the logging convention (a deliberately failed comparison produces a fully self-localizing log); the convention documented in the crate docs where every test author will see it.

title: [P0] Robot NDJSON contract + frozen-schema test
description:
[P0] Robot NDJSON contract + schema + contract test.

WHAT: versioned NDJSON events, one JSON object per line, every line carrying schema_version: run_start, stage (name/seq/elapsed/budget), frame (coarse progress, throttled), audio_chunk (byte offset, duration, packet size, sink), health, run_complete, run_error (carries the exit code). PCM NEVER interleaved with NDJSON on one stream: events on stdout with audio to -o/fd, OR --stream raw = PCM on stdout with events on stderr — one documented contract. robot schema self-describes all event types machine-readably; robot health reports model presence/arch features/threads; robot backends reports detected ISA tier + KernelPlan + pool sizing.

CONTRACT TEST: robot_contract.rs (in ftts-conformance) validates emitted events against a frozen JSON-schema fixture; schema changes require a deliberate fixture update (never silent).

WHY: agent-first ergonomics is G5; robot mode is how agent users consume ftts, and a stable versioned schema is what makes it scriptable. Model resolution errors must be ACTIONABLE (list every searched directory; cheap magic-bytes header sniff, never a tensor load).

DONE WHEN: skeleton events flow end-to-end on the empty pipeline; contract test green; schema doc emitted by robot schema matches the fixture.

(a) Skeleton events now flow end-to-end on the empty pipeline -- this was the missing piece: run_start/stage/text_prepared/run_complete/run_error were catalogued and schema-frozen but never emitted, only health and backends were. say now emits run_start -> stage(resolve) -> text_prepared -> stage(admission) -> check_complete -> run_complete, with run_error on stderr on failure; RunContext carries a shared run_id and one clock; the event stream is chosen ONCE (stdout, or stderr under --stream raw) so NDJSON can never interleave with PCM. (c) Schema doc matches the fixture, updated DELIBERATELY -- the test refused the change, I diffed emitted vs frozen and confirmed the only delta was the text_prepared addition (nothing removed, nothing changed, env vars and exit codes untouched), then copied it over as instructed. Two pre-existing defects caught by validating the whole stream: check_complete was specified to carry run_id and never did, and nothing pinned the one-object-per-line invariant -- both fixed, the latter with the newline-framing test cc_1 offered on this bead. FttsError gained remediation() so agents can branch on the next step without parsing prose. ftts-cli gained a path dep on ftts-model-qwen; validate_repo 9 rules still pass. title: [P1] Audio core (decode, exact resample, PCM IO)
description:
[P1] Audio core: WAV/FLAC decode, exact resampler, PCM emission + writers.

WHAT (ftts-core/audio, pure Rust, no libsndfile/FFmpeg FFI — SPLIT: STFT/mel lives in p1-stft-mel; VAD/quality diagnostics live in p1-audio-diagnostics): decode WAV/FLAC to f32 mono; sample-rate conversion to the model's 24 kHz with a windowed-sinc resampler whose spec is EXACT vs the reference preprocessing (differential-tested against the pinned original — any resampler mismatch shifts every downstream fixture); WAV writer including the STREAMING writer with valid-header partial finalization (the disk-full/cancellation semantics from the reliability gates); raw-PCM stdout emission (s16le/f32le, documented byte order + interleaving).

WHY EXACTNESS MATTERS HERE: audio preprocessing is Contract-A L0 — "exact" rungs are only meaningful if the front end is bit-faithful; everything else diffs against fixtures generated THROUGH this path. The resampler is the single most fixture-critical component in the audio layer.

DONE WHEN: unit tests per component with self-localizing logs (the test-observability convention); randomized differential test vs the pinned reference resampler within the measured floor; fuzz targets for WAV/FLAC parsing registered; streaming-writer failure-mode tests (truncation mid-frame, disk-full injection) green.

title: [P1] Audio quality diagnostics (VAD/clipping/SNR/reverb)
description:
[P1] Audio quality diagnostics: VAD, clipping, SNR, reverb, music, stationarity, loudness.

WHAT: the enrollment-side signal-quality toolkit (pure Rust): voice-activity detection (speech-region extraction); clipping detection (sample-domain + inter-sample peaks); SNR estimation; reverberation scoring; background-music detection; stationarity measure; loudness. Consumed by the voice compiler (ftts enroll diagnostics + warnings + the AF-4 attribute->quality loss model) — continuation-style cloners reproduce prompt-recording defects, so these detectors are what lets the tool warn BEFORE the user hears the defect in their cloned voice.

The audio CORE (decode/resample/PCM-IO) stays exactness-gated; these are QUALITY-gated.

title: [P1] Codec encoder (ICL reference tokens, exact)
description:
[P1] Codec encoder (ICL enrollment path).

WHAT: the speech-tokenizer ENCODER (geometry per OQ-7) in safe Rust: reference audio -> codec tokens for ICL prompt construction. Enrollment-only (behind the encode-capable artifact section / --with-enrollment); ordinary synthesis never carries it.

title: [P1] Codec decoder (streaming+offline, ring buffers, stream==batch gate)
description:
[P1] Codec decoder: streaming + offline, ring buffers, exact geometry.

WHAT: the speech-tokenizer decoder in safe Rust: RVQ embedding sums over the 16 code groups (high-precision codebooks); 8 transformer-like layers (hidden 512, intermediate 1024, 16 heads x head_dim 64 — attention width 1024 = 2x hidden — sliding window 72); causal convs with STATEFUL RING BUFFERS sized from OQ-7's receptive fields; upsampling [8,5,4,3] to 1920 samples per frame at 24 kHz, written STREAMING into the output PCM buffer (no re-decode of past audio). Both drive modes: offline (whole token stream) and streaming (packet-at-a-time with persistent state).

THE STANDING GATE (from day one, not retrofitted): streaming == offline decode of the same token stream, BIT-IDENTICAL target (same ops, same order — chunking must not change arithmetic); any divergence is a ledgered DISC, never silent. Plus packet-1 == packet-4 equality for the same tokens.

DONE WHEN: block-level fixture parity vs oracle (per-block activations); waveform within floor-derived tolerance of oracle decode of the SAME tokens; streaming==offline green across chunk-boundary fuzz schedules; ring-buffer state unit tests with logging.

comments.author: cc_11
comments.text:
[OQ-7 resolved -> see docs/QWEN3_TTS_CODEC_SPEC.md]

STREAMING GATE DESIGN INPUT (major finding, sec 5.2): the official decode path is
Qwen3TTSTokenizerV2Decoder.chunked_decode(chunk_size=300, left_context_size=25) -- it is ALWAYS used
(modeling_qwen3_tts_tokenizer_v2.py:1015). The pre-transformer's effective left receptive field is
568 code frames (8 stacked layers x 71 back per sliding window of 72), i.e. 23x the 25 frames the
chunker supplies. Consequences:
 (1) utterances <= 300 frames (24 s) -> single chunk, context 0 -> chunked_decode == whole-sequence
     decode. Put L4/L5 goldens HERE so they are unambiguous.
 (2) beyond 300 frames the reference is NOT equal to whole-sequence decode and is self-inconsistent.
 (3) 'streaming == batch' must therefore NAME its reference. Recommendation: target whole-sequence
     decode (the mathematically defined object); agreement with the official chunker past 300 frames
     is a separate MEASURED Contract-B row with a DISC entry -- never claimed as bit-exactness.
 (4) do NOT imitate the 25-frame-context chunker in our ring buffers; that would bake an upstream
     artifact into our engine. Correct stateful streaming needs only ~2.4-4.7 MB transformer KV
     (8x72x1024x2) + a few hundred KB conv ring buffers -- doing it right costs nothing.
Conv stack has ZERO lookahead (verified): stride-1 convs are pure left-padded causal (extra_padding
evaluates to 0); transposed convs trim kernel-stride from the RIGHT. Conv-only left context = 11.38
code frames. Full per-stage ring-buffer table in the spec doc sec 6.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text:
CONTRACT ADDENDUM — BINDING SPEC SYNC (reality-check phase 5, FuchsiaMouse, 2026-08-06). Build against docs/QWEN3_TTS_CODEC_SPEC.md, which post-dates this body:
QUANTIZER: SplitResidualVectorQuantizer — rvq_first (1 semantic, group 0) + rvq_rest (15 acoustic, groups 1-15); each with input_proj [256,512,1] / output_proj [512,256,1], bias-free k=1; RVQ math in 256-d NOT 512-d; branch results ADDED. Codebooks 2048x256. PORTING HAZARD: codebooks stored UNNORMALIZED — usable table = embedding_sum / clamp(cluster_usage, 1e-5), materialized at build time with epsilon recorded. semantic_codebook_size:4096 is DEAD CONFIG; both sub-quantizers use 2048.
PRE-TRANSFORMER (8 layers, sliding window 72): 16Q/16KV — NO GQA; QK-Norm ABSENT (nn.Identity); RMSNorm eps 1e-5 (NOT 1e-6), f32 upcast; LayerScale on BOTH residual branches init 0.01 (folding into o_proj/down_proj legal only as ledgered parity-proven transform); SwiGLU bias-free; input_proj/output_proj HAVE biases; RoPE PLAIN theta 10000 up to 8000 positions — the project's THIRD rotary kernel, never share tables.
UPSAMPLING: 1920 = 480 x 4; the x4 is upsampling_ratios [2,2] at latent_dim 1024 BEFORE the conv stack; [8,5,4,3] (tconv kernels 16/10/8/6) is the decoder, channel ladder 1536->768->384->192->96->1, BigVGAN-style with SNAKE activations (per-channel alpha/beta F32, transcendental-heavy, hot path — plan §7.2 vectorized-transcendental exception applies).
RING BUFFERS: conv-only left context 11.38 code frames (spec §6 per-stage table; worst case decoder.1 dilation-9 = 54 taps at x32 over 768 ch). Transformer retained state 8x72x1024x2 ≈ 4.7MB F32 / 2.4MB BF16. Do NOT imitate the official 25-frame chunker.
STREAMING GATE — NAMED REFERENCE: our exact target is WHOLE-SEQUENCE decode; streaming == whole-sequence offline bit-identical is the gate. Agreement with official chunked_decode(300, ctx 25) holds at <=300 frames and DIVERGES beyond — that is a MEASURED Contract-B row + DISCREPANCIES entry, never a regression.
OVERFLOW: K = 7168 (decoder.0, 1024x7), i32 headroom 9.25x — the PROJECT'S BINDING WORST CASE (2.33x the talker). Doctrine #6: this row goes in the shipped selftest; the AVX2 vpmaddubsw i16-saturation proof is owed HERE first.
BATCHED PATH: padding sentinel -1; lengths = (codes[...,0] > -1).sum(1)*1920, clamp(min=0).
FIXTURES: ft7-cpu-fp32-r1 has 80 codec arrays per mode; CPU floor max_abs 0.0 ⇒ exact compare.
OUT OF SCOPE (tracked in frankentts-5yl): ICL reference-prefix decode — do NOT assume codec decode is a pure function of the generated token stream.

title: [P1] Sequential 15-step microdecoder (authoritative baseline)
description:
[P1] Sequential 15-step microdecoder forward (the honest baseline) — teacher-forced parity per depth.

WHAT: the Residual-Code Microdecoder exactly as the official inference path runs it: after the talker samples the primary code, RESET the tiny KV state, then for residual_depth 0..14: embed the previous token with the DEPTH-SPECIFIC embedding -> 5-layer forward (1024-wide geometry, plain RoPE via apply_rotary_pos_emb semantics — a DIFFERENT rotary kernel than the talker's mRoPE) -> the DEPTH-SPECIFIC 2048-way head -> sample -> feed forward. The frame sequence is 1 conditioning/primary position + 15 residual positions = 16; each sampled residual conditions the NEXT depth (autoregressively dependent — any "depths are independent" shortcut is invalid, ledgered as such).

WHY THIS EXACT SHAPE MATTERS: this sequential loop is the AUTHORITATIVE baseline that every later lever (hot-packed engine, FrankenMTP, Q4 depths) must match bit-for-bit (greedy) or distributionally (sampled). Getting the conditioning inputs per depth right (OQ-5) is the single most dangerous correctness surface in the project.

PARITY: teacher-forced logits per depth vs oracle fixtures (all 15 depths); greedy full-frame code ids EXACT vs oracle canonical-greedy; KV-reset semantics verified (frame N cannot see frame N-1's microdecoder KV).

DONE WHEN: all 15 depths pass fixture parity; full-frame greedy ids exact over the golden corpus prefix the oracle reproduces; per-depth unit tests with logging.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text:
[from OQ-5, AzureThrush] CLAIM TIER VERDICT: **TIER 1** -- the training-mode causal forward IS mask- and distribution-equivalent to the 15-step sequential inference loop. Exact-verifier claims are LICENSED. Full line-cited derivation: docs/truth-pack/OQ5_MICRODECODER_WIRING.md.

The index map you must implement (identical in both paths, proven executably by scripts/oq5_index_equivalence.py):
  pos 0        = talker hidden state (conditioning, NOT scored)
  pos 1        = TALKER codec embedding (vocab 3072) of c0  -> lm_head[0]   -> c1
  pos 2..15    = code_predictor.codec_embedding[p-2] (vocab 2048) of c_{p-1} -> lm_head[p-1] -> c_p
Mask: plain 16x16 lower-triangular causal, positions 0..15, no sliding (all 5 layer_types are full_attention, sliding_window null). Rotary: plain RoPE theta 1e6, no scaling.

TWO TRAPS, both of which silently invalidate the epic:
1. Position 1 is SCORED. Plan §7.5's phrasing ('one conditioning/primary position plus 15 residual positions') reads as though c0's slot were unscored; it is not. Count is right, head placement is easy to get one off.
2. Position 1's embedding comes from the TALKER's table, not a code_predictor table.

NUMERICAL CAVEAT (see docs/truth-pack/OQ5_MICRODECODER_WIRING.md §6): equivalence is exact in exact arithmetic. A seq-16 batched matmul and 15 m=1 GEMVs may differ in reduction order / last ULPs. Strict-mode acceptance must compare ARGMAX/token ids, not logit bits, unless the verify kernel reproduces the sequential reduction order exactly. Ledger a DISCREPANCIES entry when the verify kernel lands.

HONESTY NOTE: this verdict is [VERIFIED-STATIC] (line-level reading of pinned source + pinned config). Numeric oracle confirmation is frankentts-m1u, blocked on the oracle env. If m1u ever contradicts this, the Tier-1 verdict re-opens and this comment is wrong.

title: [P1] Prompt/ICL assembly (4 variants, token-exact)
description:
[P1] Prompt/ICL assembly (both clone modes x both streaming modes).

WHAT: exact construction of the four prompt variants per OQ-10's documented templates: x-vector mode (speaker-embedding conditioning; injection per OQ-9) and ICL mode (reference text + reference codec tokens + target text with mode-dependent alignment), each in streaming and non-streaming form; special tokens, language tags, ordering — token-for-token equal to the oracle's assembled prompts.

DONE WHEN: assembled prompts byte-equal oracle fixtures for all four variants over the golden corpus; property tests for edge cases (empty text, very long text, multilingual spans); the independent-prefix boundary annotated in code with the OQ-10 citation.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text:
[from OQ-10, AzureThrush] All four templates documented with line citations: docs/truth-pack/OQ10_ICL_PROMPT_STRUCTURE.md §1-§3. Executable shape acceptance: scripts/oq10_prompt_shapes.py (negative-controlled) -- your implementation must reproduce these prompt/trailing/prefix lengths exactly.

THE FOUR SHAPES (H = 3 + (L_c - 1); L_c = |P| + speaker + 2; |P| = 4 if language given else 3):
  ICL x non-streaming : H + T1 + T2      two SEQUENTIAL blocks   trailing = tts_pad
  ICL x streaming     : H + T2           ELEMENTWISE SUM         trailing = text_embed[T2:]
  x-vector x streaming: H + 1            trailing = text[1:] ++ eos
  x-vector x non-strm : H + |text| + 2   trailing = tts_pad
  where T1 = |ref_id| + |text_id| + 1, T2 = 1 + ref_frames.

FOUR TRAPS:
1. DUPLICATE codec_bos. The header holds back codec_input_embedding[:, -1:] (M:2184). In x-vector modes it is consumed at M:2201/M:2220; in ICL modes it is NEVER used because generate_icl_prompt emits its own codec_bos (M:1990-1998). Emitting both gives a prompt one position too long.
2. Role positions are TEXT-ONLY -- summation with the codec stream starts at position 3, not 0 (M:2177-2186).
3. Asymmetric slicing is real and load-bearing: target text = input_id[:, 3:-5] (5-token suffix), reference text = ref_ids[:, 3:-2] (2-token suffix). It follows from _build_assistant_text vs _build_ref_text (qwen3_tts_model.py:269-273). Assert the wrapper tokenization as an L0 test -- I inferred it from the slice indices, I did not measure it.
4. tts_eos_token_id (151673) maps to a token literally named <tts_text_eod>, not eos. Use ids, never names.

DEFAULT MODE: generate_voice_clone defaults non_streaming_mode=False (qwen3_tts_model.py:478), so STREAMING is the official default for the Base checkpoint. Implement and conform that template first.

TEXT IS NOT PREFILL-ONLY: per frame the talker input is sum(16 code embeddings of the previous frame) + trailing_text_hidden[generation_step], falling back to tts_pad once exhausted (M:1689-1692). Confirms cc_1's C-1.

title: [P1] Two-level sampler (production + canonical greedy + seeded RNG)
description:
[P1] Two-level sampler: production sampling + canonical greedy + seeded RNG.

WHAT: the sampler for BOTH autoregressive levels per the pinned generation config — talker: temperature 0.9, top_k 50, top_p 1.0, repetition_penalty 1.05 (penalty semantics ported EXACTLY per the spec); residual microdecoder: temperature 0.9, top_k 50, top_p 1.0 — plus CANONICAL GREEDY mode (argmax both levels; the Contract-A conformance decoder per OQ-12) and our own seeded RNG (deterministic across runs given seed; a standing DISC entry records that we replicate the DISTRIBUTION CONTRACT, never torch's RNG stream — so free-running comparisons vs the oracle are distribution-level by design: many seeds x paired texts x rank statistics).

DONE WHEN: greedy mode exact vs oracle canonical-greedy fixtures; sampled mode statistically validated (chi-square/KS against oracle distributions at matched logits, teacher-forced); repetition-penalty unit tests from spec examples; determinism gate (same seed+inputs -> identical token streams) green.

comments.author: cc_1
comments.text:
TRUTH PACK E-2 + E-4 (frankentts-t-pin-sources-b2u) — two sampler traps.

E-4 — PRECEDENCE TRAP. code_predictor_config carries STALE HF defaults (temperature 1.0,
do_sample false). Those are NOT what runs. modeling_qwen3_tts.py:1674-1678 passes
subtalker_dosample / subtalker_top_p / subtalker_top_k / subtalker_temperature explicitly into
code_predictor.generate(). The authority is generation_config.json:
  talker:       do_sample true, temperature 0.9, top_k 50, top_p 1.0, repetition_penalty 1.05
  microdecoder: subtalker_dosample true, subtalker_temperature 0.9, subtalker_top_k 50,
                subtalker_top_p 1.0   (NO repetition penalty at the residual level)
A port reading the nested config would sample GREEDILY at T=1.0 on the microdecoder. The plan's
T0.9/k50/p1.0 was right; the precedence is the trap.

E-2 — THE TWO LEVELS HAVE DIFFERENT VOCAB WIDTHS. Talker head is 3072 wide
(codec_head = Linear(1024,3072,bias=False), :1579); the 15 per-depth microdecoder heads are 2048 wide.
Stop detection is codec_eos_token_id = 2150 on the TALKER head only. Talker control ids from
config.json: pad 2148, bos 2149, eos 2150, think 2154, nothink 2155, think_bos 2156, think_eos 2157,
and language ids english 2050 german 2053 spanish 2054 chinese 2055 japanese 2058 french 2061
korean 2064 russian 2069 italian 2070 portuguese 2071.

Third trap for the canonical-greedy ladder: max_new_tokens has THREE different upstream values —
generation_config.json 8192, qwen3_tts_model.py:2031 default 4096, README eval 2048 (gh/README.md:465).
Detail: docs/truth-pack/FACT_DISPOSITIONS.md (E-2, E-4)

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text:
[from OQ-12, AzureThrush] SAMPLER CONTRACT RESOLVED — this is what you implement. Full detail: docs/truth-pack/OQ12_SAMPLER_CONTRACT.md.

THE HIGHEST-VALUE LINE: canonical greedy is NOT 'argmax of the model logits'. Both levels run stock HF GenerationMixin.generate, where logits PROCESSORS always apply and only WARPERS are gated on do_sample. So do_sample=False still runs repetition_penalty, min_new_tokens, and suppress_tokens.
  TALKER canonical greedy   = repetition_penalty(1.05) -> min_new_tokens(2) -> suppress_tokens -> argmax
  MICRODECODER canon greedy = argmax on raw logits (it has NO processors)
A port that does bare argmax WILL diverge from the reference run with do_sample=False, and it will look like a kernel bug.

AND: argmax is invariant to the whole warper stack (temperature is monotonic; top_k keeps the max; top_p=1.0 is a no-op), so canonical greedy ids are identical with or without warpers. The canonical decoder is therefore fully defined TODAY and does not wait on the greedy-audio-viability fork.

PRODUCTION PIPELINE, exact order from transformers 4.57.3 source (_get_logits_processor):
  TALKER:       rep_penalty(1.05) -> min_new_tokens(2) -> suppress_tokens -> temperature(/0.9) -> top_k(50) -> top_p(1.0 no-op) -> softmax -> multinomial
  MICRODECODER: temperature(/0.9) -> top_k(50) -> top_p(1.0 no-op) -> softmax -> multinomial

comments.text:
[from OQ-12, docs/CANONICAL_DECODER_AND_SAMPLER.md] Your full contract is now defined -- build against
sections 2 and 4; nothing here waits on the oracle.

THE TWO LEVELS HAVE DIFFERENT PROCESSOR STACKS. Do not build one 'sampler' and apply it twice.
  Talker      (modeling:2044-2066): repetition_penalty 1.05, min_new_tokens 2, eos 2150,
              suppress_tokens = ids 2048..3071 EXCEPT 2150, then temp 0.9 / top_k 50 / top_p 1.0.
  Microdecoder(modeling:1671-1680): temp 0.9 / top_k 50 / top_p 1.0 and NOTHING else -- no
              repetition penalty, no suppression, no EOS, fixed 15 steps.

ORDER (non-commutative at every stage; reproduce exactly):
  talker: raw -> rep penalty -> min_new_tokens EOS mask -> suppress mask -> temperature -> top-k
          -> top-p -> softmax -> multinomial
  micro : raw -> temperature -> top-k -> top-p -> softmax -> multinomial
Traps: temperature BEFORE the penalty changes the penalty (it applies to raw logits); top-k AFTER
top-p yields a different candidate set than the reference's top-k-then-top-p.

REPETITION PENALTY IS SIGN-DEPENDENT (classic port bug):
  score > 0 -> score / penalty ;  score <= 0 -> score * penalty
Applied over the GROUP-0 code history only, not the full 16-code frame -- group 0 is the only thing
the talker itself emitted.

CANONICAL GREEDY (Contract A) = argmax at both levels with the NON-WARPER processors still applied
(penalty + min_new_tokens + suppress on the talker; nothing on the microdecoder). Warpers are
excluded deliberately: temperature is a monotone positive scale and top-k/top-p are truncations, so
none can change an argmax -- including them would be harmless but would misrepresent the contract.
The non-warper processors ARE included because they change which token wins.

SUPPRESS MASK IS LOAD-BEARING: talker effective support is {0..2047} u {2150}. Without the mask a port
will occasionally emit a control id (2148/2149/2154-2157) into group 0 and hand the codec an
out-of-range code -- rare and seed-dependent, exactly what the ladder is for.

RNG: replicate the DISTRIBUTION contract, never torch's stream. Scope determinism as (build, ISA,
sampler version, seed, artifact). Token-level agreement with the reference under sampling is a
DIAGNOSTIC, never a gate. You owe a DISC entry when the divergence can be MEASURED -- not before.

PIN NOTE: there are no custom logits processors anywhere in the Qwen stack, so every semantic above is
defined by pinned transformers 4.57.3. A pin change can silently change the sampler contract and must
re-run L3.

   regex, so 'match upstream' != 'match training'.

   segmentation (Thai). Ordinary prose in all ten supported languages, contractions, numbers,

title: [P2] Streaming converter (bounded memory, by-construction parity)
description:
[P2] Streaming bounded-memory converter (runtime quant first, byte-identical by construction).

WHAT: ftts convert: mmap/stream ONE safetensors tensor at a time -> validate against the WeightsManifest -> quantize in bounded tiles -> hash + write its canonical .fttsq section -> release -> atomically finalize the index. NEVER loads the whole BF16 model into a map widened to f32 (bounded peak memory on ordinary machines; no multi-GB transient).

ORDERING RULE (the by-construction parity trick): RUNTIME quantization ships FIRST (the engine can quantize from raw safetensors in-process); the offline converter then reuses the IDENTICAL quantizer function — so artifact-vs-runtime parity is byte-identical BY CONSTRUCTION, plus a test asserting it. Quantizer: per-output-channel symmetric int8, zero-point 0, scale = max|w_row|/127 (the proven frankentorch scheme); deterministic (pure function of input bytes; same source -> same .fttsq, content hash asserted; no RNG, no calibration data).

DONE WHEN: converts the pinned checkpoint under a stated memory ceiling; artifact==runtime byte-identity test green; determinism test (convert twice -> identical bytes) green; conversion provenance (source hash) embedded + verified on load.
notes: POLISH R7: explicit CONVERT E2E SCRIPT required: pinned safetensors -> ftts convert (memory ceiling asserted via RSS sampling, logged) -> census-on-load green -> .fttspack generation -> ONE REAL SYNTHESIS byte-compared to the runtime-quant path (the by-construction parity claim exercised end-to-end); every stage logs wall-clock + content hashes; this script IS the distribution-proof precursor the release bead reuses (convert byte-parity vs published hash).

title: [P2] .fttspack execution cache + KernelPlan persistence
description:
[P2] .fttspack local execution cache + KernelPlan persistence.

WHAT: the regenerable per-machine cache: keyed by {model_content_hash, kernel_abi_version, cpu vendor/model, ISA feature set, op-shape plan, packing version, quant execution mode, autotune-result hash}; contains arch-specific packed layouts (SDOT/i8mm/AVX-VNNI/AVX-512/AMX tile interleavings), the MICRODECODER HOT PACK (physically separated, layout tuned for residency across the 15 steps), and the persisted KernelPlan (which implementation wins per op x shape x regime — seeded by the -1B W8A8 bench, refined by install-time autotune). Safe to DELETE AND REBUILD at any time (regeneration deterministic given the key tuple); robot backends reports the active plan.

WHY THE SPLIT: one canonical download serves every machine; layouts evolve freely; rollback is clean; autotuning becomes an install-time freedom instead of a publishing constraint.

DONE WHEN: pack generation from .fttsq works; key-tuple invalidation tested (changing any component regenerates); delete-and-rebuild determinism test green; CI verifies every packing dequantizes to identical logical weights.

title: [P2] .fttsq canonical format + hardened reader (access classes)
description:
[P2] .fttsq canonical artifact format + hardened reader.

WHAT: the immutable, PORTABLE model container: magic FTTSQ, format_version (loader refuses newer-than-binary), model_family enum, source SHA-256 provenance, license_notice (Apache-2.0 attribution — MUST be present, per OQ-1), frozen model-config copy, tensor directory (dtype/shape/offsets/inline quant scales/group metadata), per-section SHA-256 digests, ACCESS-CLASS SECTIONS: HOT_RECURRENT_MICRODECODER (~110 MB-class: body + 15 depth heads + depth embeds + scales), HOT_RECURRENT_TALKER (~440 MB), HOT_CODEC_DECODER, COLD_TEXT_EMBEDDING (~622 MB BF16 — lazy, row-granular, NEVER WILLNEEDed wholesale), ENROLLMENT_SPEAKER_ENCODER + ENROLLMENT_CODEC_ENCODER (optional, --with-enrollment), METADATA. NO machine-specific tiling (that is .fttspack's job — the split lets kernel layouts evolve without republishing GB-scale files). Additive format evolution: new fields default-omitted + unknown-value refusal + byte-identity test for old artifacts.

HARDENING (concrete CI gates): max tensor count/rank/dims; checked arithmetic on every offset/length; overlapping-range rejection; per-section digest verification; atomic temp-write + rename; truncated-file + bit-flip tests; header size caps.

DONE WHEN: reader/writer + census-on-load; hardening tests + fuzz target green; BF16 verbatim round-trip byte-identity test green; page-in policy per access class implemented.

title: [P2] int8 heads (gated, beyond validated set)
description:
[P2] Staged quant lever 3: int8 code/lm heads (GATED — beyond the validated set).

WHAT: int8 on the talker primary head + the 15 per-depth 2048-way microdecoder heads (~31.5 MB combined). EXPLICITLY BEYOND the community-validated recipe -> ships behind FTTS_INT8_HEADS (default per measurement), each direction of the flag leaving the unarmed path structurally unchanged.

WHY GATED: heads feed sampling logits directly — the error-amplifying boundary; the protected-set doctrine keeps logits boundaries high-precision by default, so this lever must EARN its default with Contract-B budgets + listening evidence, not inherit it.

DONE WHEN: measured verdict (keep default-on / keep opt-in / revert) with Contract A+B receipts and the AF-2 tail check; ledger row with the do-not-retry predicate if reverted.

title: [P2] int8 microdecoder GEMMs (staged lever 2b)
description:
[P2] Staged quant lever 2b: int8 microdecoder GEMMs (split from lever 2a for per-stage revert granularity).

WHAT: int8 per-output-channel weights on the Residual-Code Microdecoder's 5 layers (q/k/v/o + gate/up/down; same 1024-wide geometry family as a talker layer). Its 15 per-depth 2048-way heads and per-depth embeddings are NOT in this lever (heads are lever 3, gated; embeddings follow the protected-set rules). Activation mode (W8A8 dynamic vs W8A16 weight-only) per the -1B bench winners via KernelPlan.

WHY A SEPARATE LEVER FROM THE TALKER (2a): the staging doctrine is ONE LEVER AT A TIME with per-stage revert — a Contract-B regression here must revert ONLY the microdecoder quantization, never drag the talker's landed lever with it. The microdecoder is also the QUALITY-riskier target (its codes are the acoustic detail; the first semantic-rich code flows from the talker but depths 1-15 carry sibilance/breath/pitch texture — the canary axes), and it is the PERF-critical one (its body is reread 15x/frame; int8 here is what the ~110 MB-class hot-pack residency story is built on).

GATES: ConformanceExact re-proof (teacher-forced per-depth logits within floor-derived budget; greedy full-frame ids vs the f32 baseline) + ProductionQuality budgets + the AF-2 tail gate on canary axes; revert-with-ledger on regression.

CONTEXT: franken_tts quantization spine — INT8 first (per-output-channel symmetric, i32 accumulation, fused requant); protected set stays high-precision (norms, logits boundaries, RVQ codebooks, speaker path); recipe validated against the community GGML enumeration (OQ-13).

DONE WHEN: lever landed with parity receipts (equivalence class in commit subject); FTTS_* kill-switch with structurally unchanged unarmed path; ledger row; unit tests per the test-observability convention.

title: [P2] int8 talker GEMMs (staged lever 2a)
description:
[P2] Staged quant lever 2a: int8 talker GEMMs.

WHAT (ONE LEVER AT A TIME, per-stage revert granularity — lever 2b, the microdecoder, is its own bead p2-int8-microdecoder and follows this one): int8 per-output-channel weights on the talker's q/k/v/o + gate/up/down across all 28 layers (shapes 1024->2048, 1024->1024, 2048->1024, 1024->3072, 3072->1024). Re-prove Contract A (teacher-forced ladders; greedy token stream vs the f32 baseline) + Contract B (distributional metrics within floor-derived budget). Activation mode (W8A8 dynamic vs W8A16 weight-only) per the -1B bench winners, wired per op class via KernelPlan.

KEPT HIGH PRECISION (the recipe's protected set — validated against OQ-13's GGML enumeration; any tensor THEY keep high that WE quantize is OUR risk behind a kill-switch): ALL norms (incl. QK-Norm weights), sampling-logits boundaries, RVQ codec codebooks, speaker-conditioning path, speaker-encoder output layers.

STAGING ORDER + WHY: talker (2a, this bead) -> microdecoder (2b) -> heads (3, gated) -> codec Q8 (4, listening-gated). The talker goes first because it is the LOWER quality risk (its output is one semantic-rich code the ladder verifies argmax-exactly) and it unblocks kernel work (the int8 kernel bead needs real int8 artifacts to bench against).

GATES: ConformanceExact re-proof + ProductionQuality budgets + the AF-2 tail gate; a regression reverts JUST this stage (ledgered).

[from OQ-13, AzureThrush] Reconciliation vs the community Q8 conversion (Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF @ e0f336a, 993 MB talker -- the exact artifact plan §2.2 cites). Read from GGUF bytes via scripts/oq13_gguf_tensor_types.py. Full table: docs/truth-pack/OQ13_GGML_QUANT_RECONCILIATION.md §3.

title: [P2] robot selftest + i32-overflow proofs (permanent law)
description:
[P2] robot selftest + i32-overflow proof suite (permanent law, shipped).

WHAT — TWO INSEPARABLE DELIVERABLES: (1) THE OVERFLOW PROOF SUITE: for EVERY int8 kernel class, proof that the i32 accumulator cannot overflow at THIS model's real worst-case K — unit tests multiplying worst-case saturated operands asserting i32 == i64 reference, on every kernel tier. THE K TABLE (from census; recompute if OQ-2/OQ-7 shift it): talker/microdecoder down_proj K=3072 -> U8S8 <= 3072*255*127 ~= 99.5M (>=21x i32 headroom); o_proj K=2048 -> ~66.3M; other GEMMs K<=1024; codec conv reduction lengths C_in*kernel_width from OQ-7 (whether or not im2col is ever materialized); the seq-16 verification pass shares per-element K bounds (larger m does not change per-output accumulation). (2) THE `ftts robot selftest` SUBCOMMAND: re-proves ON THE END USER'S SILICON: dispatched-kernel == scalar-oracle exact i32 equality at real model shapes for every tier the machine exposes; all overflow rows; capability-vs-actually-executed route reporting; NDJSON verdict rows. This is what the release's distribution proofs and the runtime-health scalar-fallback trigger consume.

PERMANENT LAW: every FUTURE kernel class (Q4 unpack path, codec convs, verification pass, batched variants, any Metal path) ships its own worst-case-K selftest row BEFORE it can become a default. AVX2 vpmaddubsw saturates at i16 before widening — it carries its own split-accumulate proof or a ledgered DISC.

DONE WHEN: suite covers every existing tier + the census K table; `robot selftest` emits per-row verdicts and integrates with the ISA-fallback health gate; the permanent-law rule documented where kernel authors will see it (ftts-kernels crate docs); fault-injection (a deliberately broken kernel) trips both selftest and fallback.

title: [P2] Text-embedding Q8 experiment (622->311 MB)
description:
[P2] Text-embedding Q8 experiment (footprint lever, separately gated).

WHAT: quantize the ~622 MB BF16 text embedding (151,936 x 2048) to Q8 (~311 MB saved; artifact drops from ~1.6 GB-class toward ~1.3 GB-class — NOTE the community Q8 conversion already quantizes it, which is exactly why their 993 MB talker figure looks small).

WHY SEPARATE: v1's "keep all embeddings high-precision" was too coarse — the text embedding is COLD (row-wise prefill access) with a completely different risk profile than acoustic RVQ codebooks (which stay protected). Risk surface: token-embedding perturbations propagate through the whole talker — gate on Contract-B distributional metrics + WER band + a listening spot-check, not assumption.

DONE WHEN: measured verdict with receipts; if kept, the artifact-size table updates everywhere it is quoted; ledger row either way.

title: [P4] Enrollment pipeline (diagnostics, quality/quick/auto)
description:
[P4] Enrollment pipeline: diagnostics + three modes (quality/quick/auto).

WHAT: ftts enroll end-to-end: decode/resample reference -> VAD + diagnostics (clipping, SNR, reverberation, background music, multi-speaker/overlap detection, stationarity) -> mode selection: QUALITY (transcript-backed ICL: verified transcript + codec-encoder tokens + cached prompt state — the quality path), QUICK (x-vector only: ECAPA embedding, no transcript — upstream documents possible quality reduction and the CLI says so), AUTO (ICL when the transcript verifies, else x-vector WITH A WARNING) — never presented as interchangeable equals. Warnings are LOUD (continuation-style cloners reproduce prompt-recording defects — tell the user BEFORE they hear it); refusal (exit 8) reserved for unusable input with --force for consenting adults. Consent attestation recorded; NO acquisition features (no URL fetchers) — doctrine 10.

DONE WHEN: all three modes produce working .ftvoice packs whose synthesis matches oracle-enrolled baselines; every diagnostic has a unit test with a synthetic defect fixture (clipped/reverberant/music-bed/two-speaker samples); warning + refusal paths tested; enrollment time measured.
notes: POLISH R7: explicit ENROLLMENT E2E SCRIPT required (the voice compiler's version of the CLI e2e): spawn real binaries — ftts enroll ref.wav (each of the three modes) -> ftts voice inspect --json (validate every field incl. consent + diagnostics + quality scores) -> ftts say --voice pack.ftvoice -> validate output WAV; structured logs at every stage (mode chosen + why, diagnostics values, embedding hash, token counts, synthesis timing) so a failed enrollment localizes instantly; runs model-gated in CI; reused by the release smoke suite.

title: [P4] .ftvoice + .ftvoice-cache formats (consent, profiles)
description:
[P4] .ftvoice portable format + .ftvoice-cache (the two-layer voice artifact) + VOICE_COMPILER_DESIGN.md.

WHAT: PORTABLE .ftvoice (stable identity data): reference hashes + provenance + CONSENT ATTESTATION (doctrine 10: recorded at enrollment; --consent-attest for non-interactive); transcript + alignment; selected speech regions; speaker embedding; reference codec tokens; diagnostics + enrollment-quality scores; language metadata; the REPRODUCIBLE PREPROCESSING RECIPE (so re-enrollment is deterministic); optionally embedded lossless normalized reference audio. PROFILES: --voice-pack portable (embeds reference) / private (derived features only) / minimal (embedding only) — privacy is a deliberate, documented product choice. DERIVED .ftvoice-cache (recomputable ONLY): static prompt embeddings, verified static-prefix KV, backend layouts, quantized cached states, packet-mode codec context; keyed by {voice_recipe_hash, model_hash, prompt_builder_version, streaming_mode, quant_recipe, math_mode, engine_abi}. A .ftvoice must survive a model-revision bump by re-deriving from stored primitives — caches are optimizations, never the only copy.

ALSO OWNS: docs/VOICE_COMPILER_DESIGN.md — skeleton committed with this bead (formats, profiles, privacy rationale, cache-key semantics); finalized as the Phase-4 beads land (segment discovery, transcript verification, multi-ref policies fold their design records in).

HARDENING: same acceptance criteria as .fttsq (checked arithmetic, digests, truncation/bit-flip tests, fuzz targets).

DONE WHEN: read/write + all three profiles; idempotence (identical input -> identical portable artifact, hash-stable — a metamorphic gate); cache invalidation on every key-tuple component tested; ftts voice inspect renders everything human- and JSON-readably; the design doc skeleton exists and is linked from the README docs map.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: [from OQ-10, AzureThrush] .ftvoice-cache scoping input: the provably target-independent prefix is only H + min(T2, |ref_id|) positions in ICL modes and H (7-9 positions) in x-vector modes -- reference codec frames are largely NOT cacheable. See docs/truth-pack/OQ10_ICL_PROMPT_STRUCTURE.md §5.1. Recommendation: no prefix-KV section for x-vector profiles; cache key must add (language_id, speaker_embed, ref_id, ref_code, non_streaming_mode). Also §5.2 notes an enrollment-side observation (longer reference transcripts raise the cacheable fraction) -- a bound and a direction, NOT a measured win; belongs to AF-4 ranking only if it measures out.

title: [P4] Multi-reference enrollment (selection before averaging)
description:
[P4] Multi-reference enrollment: selection before averaging.

WHAT (experimental, evidence-gated — not an upstream feature with a guaranteed recipe): for users with several short recordings: rank + select high-quality homogeneous references (the AF-4 machinery per reference); evaluate individual references on the audition benchmark FIRST; only then test embedding-level aggregation; PRESERVE per-reference embeddings + provenance always; NEVER irreversibly average away voice/style variation (averaging is not inherently superior to selecting the cleanest representative — the A/B decides).

DONE WHEN: selection-vs-aggregation A/B run through the enrollment listening protocol; the winning policy becomes the multi-ref default with the loser documented; .ftvoice stores the consensus data + all per-reference primitives; ships behind its own flag until the evidence lands.

title: [P4/AF-4] Segment discovery + audition ranking + loss model
description:
[P4/AF-4] Reference-segment discovery + audition ranking (the voice compiler's core).

WHAT (alien-artifact family AF-4 — the kernel AFs' peer; consumer: ftts enroll ranking; gate: the audition benchmark; deletion condition: selection never beats whole-file): given a longer recording: detect speech regions -> reject overlapping/multiple speakers -> score clipping/SNR/reverb/music/stationarity -> score phonetic coverage from the transcript when available -> penalize extreme emotion/whisper/atypical register unless requested -> select several candidate 3-12 s segments (submodular selection under a quality-coverage objective) -> SYNTHESIZE A FIXED AUDITION SET from each candidate -> rank by objective metrics + optional listener preference -> preserve the chosen segment AND all alternatives in the enrollment report. Plus the ATTRIBUTE->QUALITY LOSS MODEL: reference attributes (SNR, reverb, clipping, coverage) -> predicted identity/naturalness, CALIBRATED on the audition benchmark (transparency card + assumptions ledger).

WHY: this often buys more user-perceived cloning quality than another kernel lever — the reference IS the voice. Deterministic fallback (wired first): whole-file enrollment.

DONE WHEN: discovery + ranking beat whole-file enrollment on the audition benchmark (listening-protocol instance for enrollment preprocessing); loss-model calibration report committed; enrollment report format (chosen + alternatives + scores) stable.

title: [P4] Transcript verification + ASR plugin contract
description:
[P4] Transcript verification + external ASR plugin contract.

WHAT: a bad reference transcript poisons ICL enrollment silently — verify before trusting: transcript/audio duration consistency; alignment confidence scoring; obvious omission/repetition detection; an OPTIONAL external ASR verifier hook — a clean plugin/companion-tool contract (subprocess with a versioned JSON interface) because the SHIPPING BINARY CONTAINS NO ASR (G3: no foreign ML runtime; WER scorers stay eval-side); on poor confidence, a forced explicit choice: corrected-ICL or x-vector fallback (with the quality warning).

DONE WHEN: verification catches seeded transcript defects (wrong text, missing sentences, duplicated lines) in tests; plugin contract documented + demonstrated with a reference implementation script; the auto-mode decision path (verify -> ICL, else warn + x-vector) integration-tested.

title: [P5] Conditional 25Hz document-mode engine (evidence-triggered)
description:
[P5] Conditional: the 25Hz document-mode engine (dual-rate product).

TRIGGER (predefined so the decision is evidence-driven, not re-litigated): activates ONLY IF (a) the 12Hz long-form drift gate FAILS on the long-form corpus AND (b) a cloning-capable 25Hz Base checkpoint exists. Context: the paper reports the 25Hz variant outperformed 12Hz in its long-speech evaluation (attributed partly to semantic-token stability) — long-form is a DISTINCT quality regime; we never claim one checkpoint is uniformly optimal for dialogue and 2000-word narration.

IF TRIGGERED: the 25Hz document-mode engine as its own epic SHARING the artifact/kernel machinery (.fttsq model_family entry, same KernelPlan/hot-pack/conformance apparatus; a dual-rate product: interactive 12Hz + document 25Hz in one CLI). Costs to re-derive: 25Hz doubles sequential frames/s — the traffic model, residency question, and FrankenMTP economics all re-price.

IF NOT TRIGGERED: close with the evidence (drift gate green, or no cloning 25Hz Base exists) — a valid outcome.

DONE WHEN: the trigger evaluated with committed evidence; either the epic spawns (with its own -1A-class truth work for the 25Hz checkpoint) or this closes documented.

title: [P5] Drafter ladder 2-5 (distill, parallel heads, tree verify)
description:
[P5] Drafter ladder #2-#5: distillation, parallel heads, tree verify, cross-frame dynamics.

WHAT (franken_tts_lab; every output re-enters ONLY through the full verification gates): the escalating drafter program against the 15-step monster: (#2) a 1-2 layer DISTILLED microdecoder — including ORACLE RESIDUAL-TRAJECTORY DISTILLATION (teacher-forced residual trajectories from the pinned oracle are FREE supervision — no data collection needed); (#3) 15 PARALLEL residual heads off the talker hidden state (one-shot block proposal); (#4) a quantized/layer-skipped microdecoder copy as its own draft; (#5) block drafts of size 3/5 with TREE VERIFY (verify partial blocks, extend on success — trades verify passes for higher marginal acceptance); plus CROSS-FRAME RESIDUAL DYNAMICS beyond prev-frame copy (temporal structure in residual codes across frames — measure the mutual information first, build the model only if it exists); and JOINT talker->residual conditioning compression.

DECISION FRAME: each drafter is judged on the T(alpha) expected-case surface against its measured acceptance on the golden corpus vs the -1B break-even alpha*(SKU); keep/revert per drafter with ledger rows; the AF-3 monitor covers whichever ships.

DONE WHEN: at least drafters #2 and #3 built + measured; the winning drafter (if any beats #1) shipped via .fttsdraft with Contract A/B + listening receipts; losers ledgered with do-not-retry predicates.

title: [P5] .fttsdraft lab-to-runtime ABI
description:
[P5] The .fttsdraft lab->runtime ABI.

WHAT: the versioned artifact that lets lab wins land as product instead of staying notebooks: draft/surgery models (distilled drafters, parallel-head predictors, adaptive-depth variants) ship as .fttsdraft beside .fttsq — format-versioned; compatibility-keyed to {base model hash, engine ABI version, drafter type}; kill-switched (a bad draft artifact can be disabled without touching the engine); parsed by the same hardened ftts-artifacts machinery (checked arithmetic, digests, fuzz targets) with its own overflow selftest rows for any new kernel shapes.

WHY: Phase 5's entire value depends on a clean landing path; without an ABI, distillation results rot in experiment dirs. The runtime treats a .fttsdraft as an untrusted plugin: validated, gated, monitored by AF-3.

DONE WHEN: format + reader/writer + validation; a dummy drafter round-trips through it into the FrankenMTP loop; kill-switch + compatibility-refusal tested; fuzz target registered.

title: [P5] Surgery: adaptive depth, early exit, AF-1 allocation (canary-gated)
description:
[P5] Surgery experiments: adaptive depth, early exit, pruning (canary-gated).

WHAT: structural model surgery on the microdecoder (lab track): DEPTH-CONDITIONAL EARLY EXIT (emit fewer than 15 residual codes on easy frames — the codec must tolerate truncated code groups, verify against OQ-7 semantics first); ADAPTIVE microdecoder depth (a learned/heuristic controller choosing depth per frame); predictor PRUNING/layer-dropping; per-depth precision via AF-1 (the rate-distortion water-filling allocator over the (tensor x residual-depth) axes — residual depth is a semantic axis: later acoustic codebooks are plausibly less sensitive than the first semantic-rich code; artifact: bit_allocation_table in .fttsq; fallback: uniform Q8); talker Q4 only if still worthwhile after the MTP-first results.

THE GATE IS SURGERY-SPECIFIC (G1 over G2 applies doubly to surgery): beyond generic Contract B, dedicated canaries — high-frequency loss, speaker identity, SIBILANCE under shallow/adaptive residual depth (dropping late acoustic codebooks plausibly damages exactly the canary axes) — through the listening protocol with equivalence bounds; AF-2 tail gates on every surgery lever.

DONE WHEN: each experiment has a keep/revert verdict with canary receipts; kept levers ship via .fttsdraft/.fttsq behind kill-switches; AF-1's allocation beats uniform at equal footprint or is ledgered.

title: [P5] Talker-level speculation (dual-level stack)
description:
[P5] Talker-level speculation (the sibling epic — dual-level speculation).

WHAT (re-sequenced from the deleted v1 flagship — deliberately AFTER the residual layer is won): once FrankenMTP owns the microdecoder, the talker still streams ~440 MB/frame forever; dual-level speculation attacks it: a cheap talker drafter (smaller/distilled/quantized talker, or semantic-code transition priors) proposes primary codes; the full talker verifies (standard speculative decoding at the talker level — here the shared-head assumption actually holds, unlike the microdecoder); composition with FrankenMTP = speculation over the whole hierarchical AR stack.

GATES: same discipline as FrankenMTP — expected-case cost surface, break-even analysis, exactness rules per mode (greedy trivial; sampled needs the OQ-19-class rule at the talker's T0.9/k50/rep1.05), AF-3-class monitoring, strict-mode identity invariants.

DONE WHEN: go/no-go spike measured against the post-3A profile (if the talker is no longer the bottleneck per the re-ranked table, ledger and close); if go: drafter + verify loop shipped via .fttsdraft with full receipts.

title: [P6] Metal productization (full-path contract)
description:
[P6] Metal productization under the pre-stated full-path contract.

ENTRY: only if the -1B Metal microdecoder spike said GO. THE CONTRACT (pre-stated so Metal becomes a second full path, not a residual-only toy): (1) INTEGER CROSS-BACKEND CONTRACT — int8 x int8 -> i32 with post-accumulation scales gives EXACT CPU<->GPU equality regardless of accumulation order (the same trick that makes SIMD==scalar exact); the strict-mode conformance apparatus applies unchanged across backends; (2) the persistent command-graph microdecoder (the spike's design productized: 15 residual steps incl. sampling + KV updates without host round trips) PLUS a talker/codec co-residency plan; (3) CPU-FALLBACK INVARIANTS — CPU stays the default product; every Metal path has a CPU twin; the shipped selftest covers both; three independent guards (feature flag + device check + explicit env) before any GPU dispatch; (4) install-time CPU-vs-Metal benchmark policy per chip/quant/prompt-length/concurrency.

EVIDENCE CONTEXT: M5-class fused INT8 Metal precedent (Draw Things: 1.61-1.87x over FP16 matmul; INT8 attention 1.24-1.41x over Metal FlashAttention) — mechanism proof, not our targets. Sampler stays on CPU. Expect the CPU-optimal weight layout to be WRONG for GPU (per-backend layouts live in .fttspack's key space). A negative verdict at any point validly ends the epic with a ledger entry. CUDA sits behind Metal entirely.

DONE WHEN: Metal path passes the full strict-mode conformance suite with CPU-exact integer equality; the policy picks correctly per device; CPU regression suite untouched (zero-regression gate).

title: [P7] Documentation finalization (honest per-SKU numbers)
description:
[P7] Documentation finalization (honest-numbers docs, split from release mechanics).

WHAT: the shipped documentation set: README rewritten from planning-stage to product-stage (what it does, install, quickstart for say/enroll/robot modes, the four profiles, artifact story) with PERFORMANCE NUMBERS TAKEN ONLY FROM THE SCORECARD — per-SKU tables with TTFA/RTF/aggregate-RTF + the roofline-efficiency rows, never blanket claims (the honesty doctrine: no number without a receipt; NO ADMISSIBLE RATIO where no legitimate baseline exists); the responsible-use section finalized (consent attestation, no acquisition features, watermark posture per OQ-8's verdict); the docs map linking the four companion documents (QWEN3_TTS_EXECUTABLE_SPEC, PERFORMANCE_ARCHITECTURE, CONFORMANCE_AND_LISTENING, VOICE_COMPILER_DESIGN); robot-mode reference (schema, exit codes, env vars, kill-switch inventory with defaults + measured rationale); troubleshooting (doctor-first).

WHY SPLIT FROM RELEASE MECHANICS: docs are parallelizable, review-heavy, and gate on the gauntlet's numbers rather than on build infrastructure; bundling them inside the release bead made "release done" ambiguous about doc completeness.

DONE WHEN: every published number traces to a scorecard/ledger artifact (spot-audited); quickstart commands verified verbatim on a clean machine; kill-switch inventory auto-generated from code (no drift); docs reviewed against the de-slop bar (no filler, no unverifiable claims).

title: [P7] ftts doctor + CLI hardening + ergonomics audit
description:
[P7] ftts doctor + CLI hardening + agent-ergonomics audit.

WHAT: (a) DOCTOR: idempotent, reversible self-check/repair — model resolution (search path walk with actionable per-directory verdicts), artifact integrity (header sniff + per-section digest spot-check), format-version compatibility (.fttsq/.fttspack/.ftvoice/.ftvoice-cache/.fttsdraft), stale/incompatible .fttspack detection + safe regeneration offer (packs are regenerable BY DESIGN — doctor deletes/rebuilds only with explicit confirmation), permissions, toolchain/ISA reporting (capability vs actually-executed route), orphaned cache detection; every mutation through a single chokepoint, backup-aware, dry-run default for anything destructive. (b) CLI HARDENING: finalize all subcommand surfaces + help text; error messages actionable everywhere (the searched-dirs pattern); --json on every informational command. (c) AGENT-ERGONOMICS AUDIT: robot mode completeness (stable schema, deterministic where promised, exit codes exact), pipe-friendliness, no human decoration in machine output — scored against the ergonomics checklist before release.

WHY ITS OWN BEAD: doctor is the difference between "artifact mismatch error" and a self-healing install; agents and humans both depend on it when packs/models/versions drift. It consumes the artifact formats + pack regeneration machinery, hence Phase-7 placement with Phase-2 dependencies.

DONE WHEN: doctor detects + repairs every seeded fault in a fault-injection suite (missing model, corrupt section, stale pack, wrong version, bad perms) with detailed logs; idempotence proven (second run = no-op); ergonomics audit checklist green; docs updated.
notes: POLISH R7: add user-facing FIELD BENCHMARK — ftts robot bench: measures warm TTFA, single-stream RTF, and (where profile permits) aggregate RTF on THE USER'S machine with the same fairness discipline as our published numbers (warmup discard, cv% reported, thermal note), emitting NDJSON rows comparable to the per-SKU tables in PERFORMANCE_ARCHITECTURE.md. WHY: the honesty doctrine says numbers are published per SKU — this lets users verify OUR claims on THEIR silicon and gives bug reports a standard performance attachment. Reuses the bench harness + selftest machinery; no new measurement code paths.

title: [P7] fttsd OpenAI-compatible adapter (post-v1)
description:
[P7] Optional post-v1: fttsd (OpenAI-compatible speech endpoint).

WHAT (explicitly POST-v1; backlog priority): a thin companion binary exposing the engine over an OpenAI-compatible speech API (/v1/audio/speech-style), riding the 3D capacity model + admission control + capacity certificate; HTTP concerns NEVER enter the core crates (separate crate, separate binary); voice selection maps to .ftvoice packs; profiles map to request options; robot-grade structured logging; the same consent/provenance posture (server operators own their voice-pack governance).

WHY IT EXISTS AS A BEAD: makes the engine immediately useful to existing agent/app stacks without any bespoke integration — but only after the core is certified (it inherits every guarantee from the engine; it adds none of its own semantics).

DONE WHEN: endpoint serves concurrent streams within the capacity certificate; load-tested against the 3D admission behavior; API surface documented; packaged as an optional artifact.

title: [P7] Release gauntlet (three pillars, convergence)
description:
[P7] Release gauntlet: three pillars to convergence.

WHAT: the release-certification campaign per /running-the-gauntlet-on-your-rust-port: THREE PILLARS — (a) performance: honest per-stage/per-profile ratios vs the proven baseline + the ROOFLINE-EFFICIENCY rows (each hot stage within its -1B-stated factor of its floor, per SKU — the structural claim that certifies the thesis beyond incumbent deltas); (b) conformance: Contract A ladder receipts + Contract B budgets + listening equivalence + AF-2 CVaR bit; (c) surface parity: every CLI surface, robot event, and feature accounted present/partial/missing (partial never rounds up). CONVERGENCE: >=10 full find-fix rounds with >=2 consecutive clean rounds; conformal LOWER-bound ratchet (release decisions on the lower bound, never point estimates); E-PROCESSES armed over the standing invariants: streaming==batch, admission-before-allocation, i32-overflow at census K, determinism scope, SIMD==scalar, speculation-off==sequential.

ALSO: the SUSTAINED-THERMAL row (30-minute run per OQ-17's method — a turbo-window number is not an interactive-TTS claim); claims stated at their equivalence tiers throughout; NO ADMISSIBLE RATIO where no legitimate baseline exists.

DONE WHEN: convergence reached; scorecard all-green (skip-honest); evidence bundles hash-anchored under docs/gauntlet/.

title: [P7] Cross-platform release + distribution proofs + selftest
description:
[P7] Cross-platform release: builds, installer, distribution proofs, selftest.

WHAT: the 5-target release matrix (linux x86-64/arm64, darwin x86-64/arm64, windows-msvc x86-64): one SELF-CONTAINED binary per target (no Python, no foreign ML/DSP runtime, no C++ ABI, no non-system shared libraries, no network at inference; tiny audited OS-interface islands fine); runtime ISA dispatch means one binary per OS/arch covers every CPU tier. install.sh + archives + SHA-256 checksums. DISTRIBUTION PROOFS: ftts convert byte-parity vs the published artifact hash (anyone can reproduce our .fttsq from the pinned checkpoint); clean-cache pull + ONE REAL SYNTHESIS smoke test per artifact per platform. THE SHIPPED SELFTEST: robot selftest re-proves dispatched-kernel==scalar-oracle + all overflow rows + real model shapes ON THE END USER'S SILICON (capability vs actually-executed route split reported). License: Apache-2.0 attribution + NOTICE in artifacts, --version, README (per OQ-1's obligations).

ALSO: README + docs finalized (honest per-SKU numbers from the scorecard — no blanket RTF promises); the companion docs (EXECUTABLE_SPEC, PERFORMANCE_ARCHITECTURE, CONFORMANCE_AND_LISTENING, VOICE_COMPILER_DESIGN) linked as the deep documentation.

DONE WHEN: all targets build + pass the real-synthesis smoke; installer verified end-to-end on clean machines; distribution proofs recorded; selftest green on at least one user-class machine per platform family.
notes: POLISH R9 SPLIT: documentation finalization is now its own bead (p7-docs, which this bead depends on) — README product rewrite, per-SKU honest-numbers tables from the scorecard, robot-mode reference, kill-switch inventory, docs map. This bead retains: 5-target builds, installer + checksums, distribution proofs (convert byte-parity + clean-cache pull + real-synthesis smoke), shipped selftest on user silicon, license/NOTICE embedding.

title: [OQ-12b] Greedy-audio viability verdict -> L5 branch selection

comments.author: cc_11
comments.text:
Carrier for the ONE oracle-gated half of OQ-12. Definitions landed in
docs/CANONICAL_DECODER_AND_SAMPLER.md (OQ-12); this bead owns only the run-and-listen step.

QUESTION: is canonical greedy audio quality-viable? Greedy = argmax at both levels with the
reference's non-warper processors still applied (talker: repetition penalty 1.05, min_new_tokens=2
EOS mask, suppress_tokens mask over ids 2048-3071 except EOS 2150; microdecoder: raw argmax, no
penalty/mask, fixed 15 steps).

PREDECLARED CRITERION (fixed now so it cannot be rationalized later): greedy audio is quality-viable
iff, on the frozen conformance corpus, it is free of the failure modes that would make perceptual
goldens meaningless -- no degenerate repetition loops, no premature EOS, no long-silence collapse --
judged under the 9.4 listening protocol against sampled audio from the same token prefix. It does NOT
need to be as good as sampled audio; it needs to be stable enough to BE a golden. If the evidence is
equivocal the answer is L5-fixed, the branch that makes no perceptual claim.

OUTCOME: commit one of the two pre-committed branches.
  L5-greedy -> L5 means perceptual goldens + metrics over greedy audio.
  L5-fixed  -> L5 means exactness over codec-fixed audio (decode of frozen token streams) and the
               perceptual duty transfers WHOLLY to Contract B.
Never invent a tolerance to bridge them.

BLOCKED ON: frankentts-t-oracle-fixtures-6w9 (needs a running pinned reference to generate audio) and
the listening protocol.

AUTO-REOPEN on OQ-12: if the verdict contradicts the canonical-decoder DEFINITION itself -- i.e.
greedy turns out not to be a usable ladder at all, rather than merely not a golden -- reopen
frankentts-oq12-canonical-decoder-yhg, because section 2 would then be the wrong definition rather
than a definition with an open consumer.

NOT blocking: L0-L4 are unaffected by the branch, so kernel work proceeds against L4 (full
codec-token stream exact under canonical greedy), which is well-defined today.

title: [P0] check.sh must report working-tree provenance so a red gate is attributable
description:
OBSERVED DEFECT CLASS (3 occurrences, 2 near-misses of real damage): scripts/check.sh reports a red gate without saying whether the failing code is COMMITTED or is another agent's uncommitted work-in-progress. With ~12 agents editing one working tree, most reds are the latter.

Occurrences 2026-08-06:
- gate9/gate11: ftts-conformance fmt + build errors, all from an agent mid-edit.
- gateC: 'cannot find module ftts_kernels' in ftts-artifacts/src/safetensors.rs. HEAD's safetensors.rs has ZERO references to ftts_kernels and HEAD's ftts-kernels/src/lib.rs has no 'mod mmap' — the failure existed only in an uncommitted tree containing crates/ftts-kernels/src/mmap.rs (untracked) plus two modified manifests. Committed main was sound the whole time.

COST: I twice came within one command of 'fixing' another agent's live crate, which AGENTS.md forbids and which would have destroyed in-flight work. Another agent closed frankentts-aa3 correctly, and I nearly reopened it as counterfeit-green on the strength of a phantom red.

WHAT: check.sh prints working-tree provenance in its header — HEAD sha, and the count/list of modified and untracked files. On failure, if the tree was dirty, the failure block says the failure may belong to an in-flight edit rather than to committed code, and names the dirty files so attribution is one glance instead of an investigation. No behaviour change to what the gate enforces; this is purely about not misattributing its verdict.

DONE WHEN: check.sh header shows HEAD + dirty-file summary; a failure on a dirty tree prints the attribution warning naming the dirty files; a failure on a clean tree does not; gate still reaches ALL GREEN.
close_reason: check.sh now reports working-tree provenance so a red gate is attributable. Header shows 'tree: <sha> + N uncommitted path(s) — a failure below may not be yours' (or '(clean)'). On failure with a dirty tree, stage_fail prints the dirty path list, the 'git show HEAD:<file>' recipe for judging committed code alone, and an explicit 'do NOT edit another agent's uncommitted work to make this gate pass'. Clean-tree failures print nothing extra. Verified both branches by exercising stage_fail in isolation (dirty: block + file list, exit 1; clean: no block, exit 1), then live: the gateD run failed at stage 7 and correctly listed all 14 in-flight paths, locating the failure in another agent's .fttsq work in one glance. No change to what the gate enforces. Landed b6829e8.

comments.author: cc_11
comments.text:
[from OQ-7, docs/QWEN3_TTS_CODEC_SPEC.md] Codec sections ready to fold in (sec 2-5). One PLAN CORRECTION with
blast radius beyond the codec: plan sec 2.10 / 5.3 say there are TWO rotary kernels (talker mRoPE
theta 1e6 sections [24,20,20]; microdecoder plain RoPE, 16-position table). There are THREE. The
codec pre-transformer uses plain RoPE at theta=10,000 over max_position_embeddings=8000 -- different
base AND different range from the microdecoder's. It needs its own conformed kernel/table; reusing
the microdecoder's 16-row table there is a silent-corruption bug.
Other codec facts for the spec: hop math VERIFIED (upsample_rates [8,5,4,3]=480 x upsampling_ratios
[2,2]=4 -> 1920 exactly, matching decode_upsample_rate); talker->codec token map is the IDENTITY (no
offset/shift, controls are out-of-range ids >=2048); decoder pre-transformer has NO GQA (16Q/16KV)
and NO QK-Norm (q_norm/k_norm are nn.Identity) but DOES have per-channel LayerScale (init 0.01) on
both residual branches; three activation families in one decoder (SnakeBeta in the conv stack with
alpha/beta stored as LOGS, GELU in ConvNeXt blocks, SiLU in the transformer MLP).

comments.author: cc_1
comments.text:
OQ-11 input for the executable spec (from frankentts-oq11-tokenizer-p94).

The text-front-end section of QWEN3_TTS_EXECUTABLE_SPEC.md can be written from
docs/truth-pack/tokenizer/OQ11_TOKENIZER.md — it is spec-shaped already. Three things belong in the
spec verbatim because they are the traps:

1. 'verbatim' mode is now DEFINED: apply Unicode NFC, then byte-level BPE with the OFFICIAL
   (Mistral) pre-tokenizer regex, and do nothing else. No case folding, no number expansion, no
   abbreviation expansion, no punctuation rewriting, no whitespace collapsing, no NFKC.
2. NFC not NFKC (proven with 4 compatibility probes), applied INSIDE the tokenizer, not the
   processor. The Unicode version targeted by our NFC must be pinned and recorded.
3. decode(encode(x)) == x holds ONLY for NFC-normalized input. Do not spec a global round-trip law.

Also for the spec's constants table: tokenizer vocab 151,643 base / 151,676 with added specials,
versus a 151,936-row (padded) text embedding — three numbers that must not be conflated.
Reference ids for the front end: docs/truth-pack/tokenizer/tokenizer_conformance.json (92 cases).

title: [-1A] Freeze the conformance golden corpus
description:
[-1A] Freeze the conformance golden corpus.

WHAT: a deterministic-seeded, committed corpus for conformance work (DISTINCT from the bakeoff corpus): texts spanning ordinary prose, dialogue, numbers, currencies, names, acronyms, URLs, quotations, long sentences, code-switching; reference voices spanning clean/phone/reverberant/noisy conditions at 3/10/30 s; both cloning modes; short (5 s), medium (30 s), and long-form items; the canary axes explicitly present (sibilants, breaths, pitch-stable long vowels — the axes where quantization damage hides).

Reference audio must be consent-clean (own recordings / permissively licensed) per doctrine 10.

comments.author: cc_11
comments.text:
[from OQ-6, docs/QWEN3_TTS_DECODE_AND_ADMISSION.md sec 6] Long-form corpus boundary design. There are
FOUR independent boundaries; an item crossing one tells you nothing about the others. One
just-under/just-over pair each:

 1. Codec chunk_size=300 frames (24.0 s) -- items at 290/310 frames, plus 600/610 to catch the
    SECOND seam. Below 300 the official path equals whole-sequence decode; above it, it does not.
    This is the ONE boundary where our engine is deliberately NOT bit-equal to the reference, so
    these items are the DISC evidence. Mark that in the corpus manifest so a future agent does not
    read it as a parity regression.
 2. Codec left_context_size=25 frames -- content with strong long-range prosody spanning a seam (a
    sentence starting ~frame 295, ending ~320). 25 frames is 23x short of the transformer's
    568-frame horizon, so artifacts appear as prosody discontinuity, not clicks.
 3. Text-hidden exhaustion (modeling_qwen3_tts.py:1689-1692, tts_pad_embed fallback) -- (a) text much
    shorter than the natural audio, so the fallback engages early and we probe whether the model runs
    on past its text; (b) text much longer than the cap allows, probing truncation.
 4. max_new_tokens caps -- items at ~160 s (straddling the 2048 eval cap) and ~650 s (straddling the
    8192 runtime cap). Both must exercise the silent-truncation path, which is the failure this
    corpus most needs to catch.

title: [-1A] CPU-fp32 oracle nondeterminism floor (synthetic corpus, tolerance foundation)
description:
[-1A] Measure the oracle's OWN nondeterminism floor (the tolerance foundation).

WHAT: run the pinned oracle TWICE, at TWO thread counts, over the golden corpus; diff everything (activations, logits, token streams under canonical greedy, waveforms); commit the resulting nondeterminism envelope (per-token divergence rate, first-divergence positions, per-layer max-abs spread) as a fixture.

WHY THIS IS NON-NEGOTIABLE: every Contract-A tolerance is DERIVED from this envelope — never imported from another project or model (a tolerance encodes a specific shape/depth/precision; the sibling projects' numbers are meaningless here). A subject divergence INSIDE the oracle's own bf16 noise is not a bug. L4 "exact" is defined only over the prefix the oracle reproduces identically. Without this measurement, "bit-exact" claims are unfalsifiable and agents will invent epsilons (which Doctrine 0 forbids — silent tolerance widening is a ledgered, gated operator).

DONE WHEN: envelope fixture committed; a short doc states the derived tolerance per ladder rung; the ladder runner (verification epic) reads tolerances FROM this artifact, not from constants.
close_reason: CPU-tier repeatability envelope committed in 06cb4ba; rescope moved CUDA/cross-device work to frankentts-u8s.

[-1A] Stand up the pinned reference oracle + fixture generator (ORACLE BEFORE ENGINE).

description:
[-1A] Pin, hash, and snapshot every load-bearing source. THE FIRST EXECUTABLE ACT of the project — nearly everything else depends on it.

WHAT: pin exact immutable revisions of (a) HF Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base (config.json, generation_config.json, speech_tokenizer/config.json, tokenizer files, all weight shards — verify via LFS etags), (b) the official GitHub repo QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS (modeling_qwen3_tts.py at qwen_tts/core/models/, processor/prompt code, cloning + streaming entrypoints), (c) the paper (arxiv 2601.15621). SHA-256 every file; snapshots gitignored, hashes committed under docs/truth-pack/; write a re-fetch script with --verify. Runtime pins (torch/transformers/qwen package versions) come from the README/model card, NEVER config metadata (the sibling project caught a config lying about its transformers version at pin time) — asserted at oracle runtime by OQ-15.

WHY: plan v1 contained a load-bearing architecture error (missed that the "MTP module" is a 15-step autoregressive microdecoder) because facts were unpinned. All [SOURCE]-tagged facts in plan section 2 (URLs in section 17) must be re-asserted against these pinned bytes and promoted to [VERIFIED] or corrected — and every correction must propagate to the affected beads.

DONE WHEN: docs/truth-pack/ contains hash manifest + pin record + re-fetch script; every plan section-2 fact has a VERIFIED/CORRECTED disposition; corrections (if any) filed as comments on affected beads.
notes: POLISH R3: acceptance sharpened — the re-fetch script's --verify mode re-downloads (or re-hashes cached copies) and asserts every SHA-256 in the manifest; CI can run it in a weekly cron to detect upstream force-pushes/drift. A hash mismatch after pin is a STOP-THE-LINE event (the truth pack is the foundation of every other bead).

HF Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base @5d839924 + GH QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS @022e286b + arXiv 2601.15621v1 pinned; 38 sources snapshotted and SHA-256'd in MANIFEST.sha256; weight integrity via LFS oids (WEIGHTS.lfs.json). fetch-truth-pack.sh --verify tamper-tested (exit 2 on mutation, 0 restored). All plan section-2 facts adjudicated in FACT_DISPOSITIONS.md: 6 CORRECTED, 5 EXTENDED, rest VERIFIED (section 2.6 traffic model reproduces exactly). Corrections filed as comments on 12 affected beads; 4 surgical plan edits applied.

title: [-1A] Seed ledgers (DISCREPANCIES/NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE/PERF_LEDGER) + inherited priors
description:
[-1A] Seed the three evidence ledgers + import inherited priors.

WHAT: create docs/DISCREPANCIES.md (every accepted numeric divergence: reference behavior, our impl, MEASURED impact, kill-switch env var, review date), docs/NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE.md (every rejected optimization: the graveyard, with do-not-retry predicates and W/L/N tallies), docs/PERF_LEDGER.md (artifact-graph rows: claim_id, evidence_id, model-source commit + fixture hash, CPU feature string, exact command + env, kill-switch state). Seed them EMPTY on day 0, then import the sibling-project graveyard (franken_ocr / frankensearch / franken_whisper) as entries labeled "inherited (pre-truth-pack)" — priors to RE-CONFIRM locally, never treated as local evidence.

KEY INHERITED PRIORS to import: hand-wide-SIMD over scalar glue ~5x SLOWER than LLVM autovec; unblocked SMMLA is load-bound (slower than SDOT); autovec beat hand-SDOT at m=1 on M4 (4.4x); int4 without native packed dot = 2.5x memory traffic (5.8x slower); AMX-f32 loses to int8; naive fused ops regressed 3-10x; thermal drift 30%+ on unchanged code (interleaved A/B pairs mandatory).

WHY: the graveyard is swept BEFORE spending any perf lever (the Phase-4 ritual's step 1); without it, agents re-try measured-dead ideas.

DONE WHEN: three ledgers exist with headers + inherited-prior sections; referenced from AGENTS.md workflow.
close_reason: Seeded gate-consumed evidence ledgers; recorded seven inherited pre-truth-pack priors; added AGENTS workflow reference.

title: [VER/AF-2] CVaR/EVT tail-risk release gate
description:
[VER/AF-2] Tail-risk release gate: CVaR/EVT over WER + identity + drift.

WHAT (alien-artifact family AF-2 — consumer: the release ship gate as a NAMED BIT; deletion condition: never, while any lossy lever ships — it IS the tail gate): compute per-utterance quality metrics over the golden corpus and gate releases on the WORST alpha-fraction (CVaR) plus an EVT (generalized-Pareto) tail estimate — never the mean. TTS fails in the tail: hallucinated/repeated/skipped words, premature endings, identity drift on hard texts; a quant choice can look fine on mean-WER while wrecking sibilance-heavy or number-dense items.

MECHANICS: tail_risk_monitor emitting (mean, CVaR_alpha, EVT_p99x) per metric family; canary axes (sibilants, breaths, noisy references, code-switching, numbers, long form) reported separately; the release scorecard consumes the CVaR bound as a hard bit. Fallback (deterministic, wired first): the offending lever ships one precision tier higher or off.

DONE WHEN: monitor implemented over Contract-B outputs; thresholds set from the -1B/f32 baseline distributions; wired into the Phase-2 staged-lever gates and the Phase-7 scorecard; transparency card + assumptions ledger committed.
notes: POLISH R3: estimator self-tests required — CVaR and the EVT (generalized-Pareto) tail fit validated on synthetic distributions with KNOWN tail parameters (recovery within stated error) before thresholds are trusted; also document the sample-size floor below which the EVT fit refuses to emit a number (refusal over noise, per honesty doctrine).

title: [VER] Fuzzing (parsers, tokenizer, audio, chunk schedules)
description:
[VER] Fuzzing: artifact parsers, tokenizer, audio, text, chunk schedules.
