title: [VER] ConformanceExact ladder runner (skip-honest receipts)
description:
[VER] Contract A harness: the ConformanceExact ladder runner.

WHAT: the reusable harness in ftts-conformance implementing Contract A: seam comparators (cosine + max-abs + fingerprints) reading tolerances FROM the committed nondeterminism-floor artifact (never constants — silent epsilon bumps are a ledgered, gated operator, not an edit); teacher-forced runners for talker layers, all 15 microdecoder depths, codec blocks, ECAPA; canonical-greedy generation compare; the one-command ladder scorecard with SKIP-HONEST receipts (skipped-with-reason is distinct from green; XFAIL never SKIP; forced all_green=false when anything skipped); EngineIdentity::{Subject,Oracle} asserted-distinct so the oracle is never compared against itself; the comparator bridge is test-only, NEVER linked into the shipping binary (G3's no-foreign-runtime claim).

title: [VER] Listening protocol operationalized (ABX/TOST/margins/owners)
description:
[VER] The operationalized listening protocol (docs/CONFORMANCE_AND_LISTENING.md).

WHAT: the human-evaluation apparatus, OPERATIONALIZED BEFORE FIRST USE (otherwise the boldest quality machinery cannot actually gate a lever): ABX speaker-identity tests (reference A; candidates B/C) + pairwise/MUSHRA-style naturalness; PREDEFINED smallest effect size of interest + TOST equivalence margins PER METRIC FAMILY (we demonstrate equivalence, never mistake failure-to-reject for it); hierarchical analysis over speaker/text/language/listener; tail reporting on the canary axes (noisy references, sibilants, breaths, code-switching, numbers, long form); the listener-pool recruitment plan + a NAMED OWNER for the power analysis; the AUTOMATION BOUNDARY (objective proxies run CI-nightly; human panels run at quantization gates + releases); the RELEASE BINDING (AF-2's CVaR bound is a named bit in the ship gate, not advisory).

WHY: audio claims need EARS (doctrine 8) — embedding cosine is secondary; but un-powered listening ("several hundred undifferentiated judgments") is theater. Separate protocol instances serve: model selection (bakeoff Gate A), quantization gates (Q8/Q4), enrollment preprocessing (voice compiler).

DONE WHEN: the document committed with all margins/owners/boundaries filled in; a pilot ABX run end-to-end validates the pipeline; harness scripts reusable by bakeoff + quant + enrollment beads.
close_reason: Operationalized §9.4 into docs/CONFORMANCE_AND_LISTENING.md §4 + an executable harness at scripts/listening/ (stdlib-only: TOST/non-inferiority with a three-valued verdict, by-listener AND by-speaker cluster analyses, ICC/design-effect diagnostics, AF-2 CVaR tail gate calibrated against a sign-flip permutation null, predeclared screening, blinded plan/sealed key, seeded synthetic panel). Margins/SESOI/design/instances live in margins.toml (policy_version 2026-08-06.1, PROVISIONAL) so doc and enforcement cannot drift. Named LPO owner bound to a person and enforced at load. Automation boundary enforced in code (objective_only instances refuse panel families). Release binding = named bits + stable exit codes 0/1/2/3/4; gate refuses synthetic or provisional-at-release verdicts by default. Pilot: selftest exit 0, 7/7 scenarios green incl. negative control (identity -0.15 -> FAIL), insufficient-power control (-> INSUFFICIENT_POWER, required_n 178 reported), and canary-axis-only control (sibilants -0.30 invisible to the pooled test -> tail_cvar_bound FAIL). Measured between-listener SD 0.121 vs assumed 0.12; required_n 23 vs design 24. Harness reusable by bakeoff/quant/enrollment/surgery/release instances. Gates: ubs 0 critical (37 division + 4 float-eq warnings are guarded Lentz-algorithm/exact-zero sentinels; 9 json.loads warnings are handled by main()'s ValueError->exit 4). No Rust gates run: no Cargo workspace exists yet (frankentts-p0-workspace-zri) and this change adds zero Rust. CI wiring noted on frankentts-p0-ci-083.

title: [VER] Metamorphic invariants + golden artifacts
description:
[VER] Metamorphic invariants + golden artifacts.

WHAT — THE INVARIANT LIST (each an automated test; each optimized path carries its OWN greedy token-identity proof against sequential — per-path, not global): batch==singleton (strict mode); packet-1==packet-4 for the same codec tokens; prompt-cache==full-prefill; streaming codec==offline codec; identical voice input -> identical portable .ftvoice (hash-stable); scalar==SIMD on every tier; thread-count invariance (strict); corrupted/truncated artifacts always fail BEFORE inference; greedy FrankenMTP ids == greedy sequential ids; AF-3 alpha->0 == sequential path byte-for-byte (strict); verify-then-repair can never emit a depth sequence impossible under the training-mode causal mask.

EXPLICITLY NOT AN INVARIANT (deleted in review): "trailing punctuation must not change the spoken prefix" — punctuation legitimately alters preceding prosody in a text-conditioned AR model; that is a behavior study, not a gate.

GOLDEN ARTIFACTS: exact codec-token streams (insta-style); fuzzy/ULP logits; scrubbed robot NDJSON (timing/run-id removed); per-platform PCM content hashes (cross-BUILD outputs compare by content metric, never byte identity — LTO reorders f32); UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 with mandatory diff review; *.actual gitignored; CI never auto-updates.

DONE WHEN: all invariants implemented + wired to CI; golden inventory documented; the FrankenMTP invariants activate when 3A lands (registered now, model-gated).

title: [VER] ProductionQuality harness (distributional + free-running)
description:
[VER] Contract B harness: ProductionQuality metrics.

WHAT: the distributional + free-running quality harness: TEACHER-FORCED distributional metrics (per-level per-depth logit KL/JS divergence, top-k set overlap, reference rank of selected token, first-divergence position distributions) and FREE-RUNNING metrics under the production sampler (ASR-scored WER via pinned eval-side scorers — never linked into ftts; repeated/skipped-word rate; stop-token errors; speaker-identity scores with MULTIPLE unrelated embedding encoders, explicitly SECONDARY to human listening; prosody measures; long-form drift metric — the distinct-regime gate motivated by the paper's 25Hz-beats-12Hz long-speech result). Free-running comparisons are DISTRIBUTION-LEVEL BY DESIGN: many seeds x paired texts, rank statistics + equivalence bounds — never single-seed A/B (we do not replicate torch's RNG stream; standing DISC).

WHY: Contract B is the INT8/lever shipping gate (full token equality is only a diagnostic there); model surgery later needs surgery-specific canaries (high-frequency loss, identity, sibilance under shallow residual depth) which plug in here.

DONE WHEN: harness computes all metric families over the golden corpus; CI-nightly objective-proxy subset wired; report format feeds the release scorecard.
notes: POLISH R3: the harness itself must be self-tested — each metric implementation (KL/JS, top-k overlap, reference rank, WER pipeline, drift metric) validated against hand-computed reference values on synthetic distributions before it may gate anything; a metric harness with a bug silently green-lights broken levers.

title: [VER] Reliability gates (admission, health, streaming failures)
description:
[VER] Reliability gates: admission, runtime health, streaming failure semantics.

WHAT: (a) RESOURCE ADMISSION — before synthesis, compute and validate: token count, predicted max frames (from OQ-6 stop rules + hard duration limit), KV allocation, codec state, voice-cache footprint, concurrency budget, total memory reservation; REJECT BEFORE PARTIAL ALLOCATION (never die halfway through a long generation). (b) RUNTIME HEALTH — NaN/Inf checks at configurable seams; no-progress frame watchdog; EOS/max-duration consistency; repeated-token runaway detector; output-silence detector; FALLBACK from an optimized ISA kernel to the certified scalar baseline after selftest failure; thermal-degradation reporting on sustained runs. (c) STREAMING FAILURE SEMANTICS (defined + tested): consumer stops reading -> producer parks, budget then cancels; sink write error -> drain + structured error; event-sink blocking -> audio and event channels CANNOT deadlock each other (separate bounded queues, independent shutdown); cancellation during codec emission -> finalize at frame boundary; disk-full -> partial-WAV finalization with valid header.

WHY: correctness work concentrates on numerics; production TTS dies on hostile/broken inputs and stuck consumers. admission-before-allocation is an e-process invariant in the release gauntlet.

DONE WHEN: each gate implemented + failure-injection tested with detailed logging; health events flow through SynthesisObserver/robot; documented in the reliability section of the conformance doc.
close_reason: All three gates implemented and failure-injection tested. (a) RESOURCE ADMISSION landed earlier (4b6a71b, bc45173): OQ-6 rule verbatim, three worked points asserted exactly (512+2048=280MiB, 512+8192=952MiB, 32768=3.50GiB), enforced at the engine seam before any stage runs — proven by the ABSENCE of a stage event; overflow refuses rather than clamps; truncation is a reported StopReason, not a silence. (b) RUNTIME HEALTH (3627c58, ftts-core/src/health.rs): seven detectors — NumericGuard (first offending index), ProgressWatchdog, check_stop_consistency, RunawayDetector (stuck token AND short cycle), SilenceDetector, KernelSelector (one-way demotion), ThermalReporter. Seam policy explicit; Off reports is_checking()==false so a run under it is UNCHECKED not clean; a zero sampling interval checks rather than disables. Violations reach the caller via SynthesisObserver as HealthEvent::Violation, each carrying a remedy and whether it invalidates output. (c) STREAMING FAILURE SEMANTICS (ftts-core/tests/streaming_failures.rs): 7 tests that INJECT each plan-9.6 failure — consumer stops reading, event consumer blocks, audio consumer blocks, consumer disappears, cancellation mid-emission stops on a packet boundary, disk-full finalises a partial WAV with both RIFF and data sizes patched to what landed. Documented in docs/CONFORMANCE_AND_LISTENING.md section 5, including 5.5 'What is not yet wired'. One real defect found and fixed: SilenceDetector compared integer milliseconds, so at 24kHz a 100ms window and 2401 silent samples both rounded to 100ms and the boundary case never fired; it now compares in samples. GATE: cargo test --locked --workspace all green (ftts-core 38 unit + 7 integration); clippy -p ftts-core --all-targets -D warnings clean; fmt applied. ubs: 3 criticals reviewed and rejected as false positives — 'let token = cancellation.clone()' matches a hardcoded-secret heuristic on the variable NAME (it is a CancellationToken) and the panic! is in a cfg(test) module. RESIDUAL, tracked as frankentts-f7o and NOT claimed here: the detectors have no model to observe yet (Phase 0 has no decode loop), so seam wiring, the robot-NDJSON side of health events, and replacing ftts-cli's scaffold admission_plan() with ftts_core::admission all land with their components.

comments.author: cc_11
comments.text:
[from OQ-6, docs/QWEN3_TTS_DECODE_AND_ADMISSION.md sec 4-5] Two concrete requirements:

SILENT TRUNCATION must become a reported outcome. When max_new_tokens is reached without EOS, the
reference (modeling_qwen3_tts.py:2283-2290) sets effective_lengths to the full generated length and
returns truncated audio with NO exception, NO warning, NO flag -- the caller cannot distinguish 'the
model finished' from 'the model was cut off'. ftts is agent-facing and an agent cannot hear that the
audio stopped mid-word, so this needs a distinct robot-mode field and a distinct exit path. Per
Doctrine #0, silently returning a cut-off utterance is a counterfeit success.

ADMISSION RULE (reject before partial allocation):
  predicted_max_frames = min(max_new_tokens, 32768 - L_prompt)
  predicted_peak_bytes = KV_talker(L_prompt, predicted_max_frames) + 320 KiB + 2.25 MiB
                         + ring_buffers + weights_resident
  admit iff predicted_peak_bytes <= budget
where KV_talker(L,N) = (L+N) x 57,344 x sizeof(dtype)  [28 layers x 2 x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim
= 57,344 values/token = 112 KiB/token BF16]. Worked points: 2048-frame cap + 512-token prompt =
280 MiB; 8192-frame cap + 512-token prompt = 952 MiB; full 32768 context = 3.50 GiB.
Bounded terms that do NOT grow with duration: microdecoder KV 320 KiB (5 layers x <=16 positions,
per-frame reset), codec decoder KV 2.25 MiB (8 layers x window 72 x 16 x 64 x 2), codec conv ring
buffers a few hundred KiB. max_new_tokens is the binding constraint at every realistic prompt
length -- the 32768 ceiling only binds above ~24,500 prompt tokens, unreachable under the 8192 cap.

comments.text:
cc_1 2026-08-06 ~15:10 UTC: gate (a) RESOURCE ADMISSION landed + truncation outcome. Committed by a

GATE: cargo test --locked -p ftts-core = 16 passed / 0 failed (10 new admission tests);
clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; fmt clean.

(a) RESOURCE ADMISSION -- DONE. Implements cc_11's OQ-6 rule verbatim. Distinct from the engine's
existing CONCURRENCY admission (the one-live-synthesis lease); this one answers "will it fit".
  - The three worked points are asserted EXACTLY, so a formula drift fails a test rather than
    silently changing capacity: 512+2048 = 280 MiB, 512+8192 = 952 MiB, 32768 = 3.50 GiB.
    112 KiB/token at BF16 pinned separately.
  - Rejections are actionable: BudgetExceeded carries the whole plan (binding constraint, frames,
    shortfall) so a caller knows whether to shorten text, lower the cap, or raise the budget.
    PromptExceedsContext is a separate variant because no amount of memory fixes it.
  - Overflow is its own refusal, never a saturating clamp -- a wrapped total is a small plausible
    number that would admit a request certain to die mid-generation.
  - Boundary tested: peak == budget admits, peak-1 does not.

TRUNCATION -- DONE, per cc_11's first requirement. StopReason: only EndOfSpeech is
is_clean_completion(); FrameCapReached / DurationLimitReached are is_truncated() and each carries a
remedy string. The reference returns cut-off audio with no exception/warning/flag and an agent
cannot HEAR the difference, so it is inspectable instead.

REMAINING -- NOT started, and both need engine wiring rather than pure computation:
  (b) RUNTIME HEALTH: NaN/Inf checks at configurable seams, no-progress frame watchdog,
      EOS/max-duration consistency, repeated-token runaway detector, output-silence detector,
      ISA-kernel -> certified-scalar fallback after selftest failure, thermal reporting.
  (c) STREAMING FAILURE SEMANTICS: consumer-stops-reading -> park then budget-cancel; sink write
      error -> drain + structured error; audio and event channels cannot deadlock each other;
      cancel during codec emission -> finalize at frame boundary; disk-full -> partial-WAV
      finalization with a VALID header.
Note ftts-core already has the independent bounded PCM/event queues (c) builds on, and
StopReason::Cancelled is the vocabulary the cancel-at-frame-boundary case needs.

does not run it, and ftts-cli's `say --check` still uses its own scaffold admission_plan(). Wiring
it into both is the obvious next increment and does not depend on (b) or (c).
